about: The card-triage need vocabulary beyond top-commanders-gaps.json's features: every key a blocked record in data/sweep-*/ uses resolves through `aliases` to one of those features or to an entry in `features` here (a narrower need, filed under its `family`). `example` is the first record that named it. A need that lands goes into top-commanders-gaps.json's `built` array, whichever file defines it. Tooling: npm run cards:needs -w engine (scripts/needs-vocabulary.mjs).

amount:coin-flips-won-this-way.example: Crazed Firecat: flip until you lose, then one placement of a +1/+1 counter for each flip won — flip-coin's untilLose applies its won effect once per win.

bug:additional-cost-option-affordability.example: Eaten Alive: Its "pay {3}{B}" additional-cost option is offered even when the mana can't be paid, and taking it throws (fuzzer seeds 4, 27, 31).

bug:attackers-through-end-of-combat.example: Desert: engine clears attacking status as the end of combat step begins (rule 511.3 says as it ends), so 'target attacking creature' during that step has no legal target

bug:cda-cards-exiled-with.example: Unlicensed Hearse: No 'up to two targets from a single graveyard' relation, nor a P/T CDA counting cards exiled with it.

bug:cda-counter-total.example: Toph, the Blind Bandit: CDA power = +1/+1 counters on lands you control: no counter-sum CountSpec for setBasePtFromCount

bug:cda-devotion.example: Daxos, Blessed by the Sun: Toughness equal to devotion to white: a CDA count can't read devotion.

bug:cda-sum-of-counts.example: Abomination of Llanowar: CDA is Elves you control plus Elf cards in your graveyard — setBasePtFromCount takes a single CountSpec, no sum.

bug:commander-mv-battlefield-or-command-.example: Majestic Genesis: greatestCommanderManaValue counts commanders in every zone; card counts only battlefield and command zone

bug:creature-subtype-needs-creature-type.example: Archangel Elspeth: add-types keeps a non-copiable Angel subtype on a permanent that stops being a creature; the ruling says it stops being an Angel.

bug:defending-player-after-removal.example: Armix, Filigree Thrasher: Reflexive target 'creature defending player controls' reads live attacking; rule 508.5 keeps the defending player if Armix left combat.

bug:delayed-sacrifice-by-you.example: Come Back Wrong: sacrifice-target makes the permanent's current controller sacrifice it; the card has you sacrifice it, so it does nothing if someone else has taken control

bug:distinct-targets-across-slots.example: Ghostly Flicker: 'Two target …' needs two different objects, but separate target slots aren't checked against each other. The reviewer had a cast with the same permanent in both slots accepted.

bug:disturb-exile-replacement-as-ability.example: Lunarch Veteran: Luminous Phantom's "exile it instead" is done by the disturb cast path, not as its own ability, so a copy doesn't exile and Humility doesn't stop it (Hook-Haunt Drifter shares it).

bug:each-player-reanimate-simultaneous.example: Exhume: each player's chosen card must enter simultaneously; for-each-player look-and-choose moves them one at a time

bug:extort-life-lost.example: Crypt Ghast: The extort helper gains one life per opponent rather than the life actually lost (ruling: with Platinum Emperion you gain nothing). The Swamp mana trigger is expressible.

bug:found-card-wherever-it-went.example: Oriq Loremage: "If it's an instant or sorcery card" reads only a card that reached the graveyard; under Rest in Peace the found card is exiled and should still count.

bug:granted-trigger-identity.example: Dionus, Elvish Archdruid: once-each-turn is tracked per ability index of the Elf, so a new Dionus's grant (a different ability per the ruling) or two Dionuses' grants can't be told apart

bug:mana-trigger-color-choice.example: Fertile Ground: 'Adds an additional one mana of any color' on a land tapped by hand: a tapped-for-mana extra of any colour is made white there, with no choice.

bug:milled-cards-in-any-public-zone.example: Bramble Familiar: Fetch Quest looks for the milled cards only in the graveyard; with Rest in Peace they're in exile and it should still find them (rule 701.17c).

bug:mixed-simultaneous-entry.example: Sword of Hearth and Home: The exiled creature and the found basic land enter together; a flicker and a search are two entries.

bug:oring-one-shot-return.example: Cast Out: its ruling: the card returns immediately as Cast Out leaves, nothing in between; the engine's O-Ring return is a leaves-battlefield trigger on the stack

bug:play-mdfc-land-face-from-graveyard.example: Ancient Greenwarden: 'You may play lands from your graveyard' should let you play an MDFC's land back face (ruling). playFromGraveyard matches the card's front face, so the permission misses it. The trigger-doubling half is fine.

bug:return-from-graveyard-reads-x.example: Ascend from Avernus: return-from-graveyard's filter isn't given the spell's X

bug:return-source-card-from-graveyard.example: Journey to Eternity: 'then return this card transformed' needs the Aura's new graveyard object; 'source' is lost after its zone change

bug:return-transformed-non-dfc-stays-exi.example: The Restoration of Eiganjo: ruling: a non-DFC told to return transformed stays in exile; flicker transformed returns it as usual; no transforming-Saga precedent

bug:return-without-abilities-as-it-enter.example: Xu-Ifit, Osteoharmonist: ruling: loses ETB/as-enters abilities before they apply; engine would add the type/ability loss after it enters

bug:reveal-from-hand-reads-changeling.example: Murmuring Bosk: Reveal a Treefolk card from hand: revealableFromHand reads printed subtypes, so a changeling card isn't offered (rule 702.73a).

bug:reveal-or-control-condition.example: Temple of the Dragon Queen: Enters tapped unless you revealed a Dragon card or control a Dragon: the reveal and the board condition each force it tapped (an AND), not either one sparing it.

bug:saga-exile-return-transformed.example: Welcome to . . .: Per-opponent artifact animation 'for as long as you control this Saga' plus exile-and-return transformed into Jurassic Park.

bug:self-or-another-trigger.example: Beregond of the Guard: "This or another X" as one trigger misses its own entry when it isn't an X (a copy, Conspiracy); needs the self + otherOnly split.

bug:spell-copy-keeps-sacrificed.example: Tend the Pests: Ruling: copies use the original's sacrificed creature's power, but copySpellFrom doesn't carry lastKnownRefs.sacrificed, so a copy would make 0 Pests

bug:spell-target-filter-reads-x.example: Profane Command: 'Up to X target creatures gain fear' (a target count of X in a castModal mode) and 'creature card with mana value X or less' in a spell's target filter (AUTHORING §6: a spell's target filter can't read X).

bug:split-half-colors.example: Life: Life // Death's halves have different colours (rule 709.3); no pool split card has differing halves yet, and card:verify compares halves to the whole card's colours.

bug:stacking-draw-replacements.example: Phial of Galadriel: ruling: two Phials draw three; engine takes the max of 'draw N instead' replacements (drawCountFor) rather than applying each

bug:target-filter-x-activated.example: Lazotep Quarry: A target with mana value X on an activated ability, untested; left for a check.

bug:target-permanent-of-targeting-player.example: Scalelord Reckoner: 'that player' (the opponent who targeted the Dragon) as a permanent target's controller is unconfirmed for becomes-target triggers

bug:this-cycled-trigger.example: Dismantling Wave: 'For each opponent, … up to one target … that player controls': target options are filtered by a pure function with no state (slotOptions), so one-per-opponent needs plumbing through the offer, validation, client and bot

bug:token-copy-as-enters-choices.example: Ardyn, the Usurper: ruling says the token copy's 'as enters' abilities work; a token copy isn't asked them (§15)

bug:trigger-relative-target-filter.example: Gale, Waterdeep Prodigy: Target 'card of the other type' depends on the triggering spell's type; only expressible by splitting the one ability into two triggers.

bug:turn-history-descended-as-it-arrived.example: Raphael, Fiendish Savior: descended filter reads the card as it is now, not as it was put into the graveyard

condition:adamant-colorless.example: Desecrate Reality: no even/odd mana value filter; adamant on colorless mana unverified

condition:any-graveyard-size-condition.example: Visions of Beyond: conditions only count your own graveyard, not 'a graveyard has twenty or more cards'

condition:attached-host-condition.example: Champion's Helm: "As long as equipped creature is legendary, it has hexproof": no static condition asks about the permanent an Equipment is attached to.
condition:attached-host-condition.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): No count of Auras on the host (Face of Divinity's another Aura; only a boolean enchanted exists) and no host controller's graveyard count (So Tiny). Already there: engine/src/cards/define.ts source condition (around line 1149) with a filter whose attachedTo clause matches the host (engine/src/filter.ts lines 1398-1410), e.g. legendary host via supertype

condition:attacking-alone-condition.example: Security Bypass: 'as long as enchanted creature is attacking alone, it can't be blocked' has no StaticCondition

condition:attacking-an-opponent-filter.example: Oviya, Automech Artisan: 'attacking one of your opponents' (not a planeswalker) has no filter; put creature/Vehicle from hand with conditional artifact counters also unproven

condition:cant-be-blocked-except-by-flyi.example: Signal Pest: CardFilter has only one notKeyword; can't say 'neither flying nor reach'

condition:card-left-graveyard-condition.example: Essence Anchor: 'Activate only if a card left your graveyard this turn' — the used-graveyard-this-turn condition asks something else (a spell cast or ability activated from a graveyard).

condition:cards-currently-exiled-with-so.example: Evercoat Ursine: intervening-if 'if there are cards exiled with it' means still in exile; the exiled-with-source condition counts cards ever exiled, so the trigger would still fire after both were played

condition:cast-timing-condition.example: Return to Dust: 'If you cast this spell during your main phase' gates the second target on how it was cast.

condition:compare-each-other-player.example: Battle Angels of Tyr: Myriad plus checks against each other player's hand and lands.

condition:compare-to-chosen-value.example: Talion, the Kindly Lord: 'Choose a number between 1 and 10' as it enters, then matching a spell's mana value, power or toughness to it, has no filter comparison against a chosen value, and the choice would only fire when it's cast.

condition:condition-cards-in-all-graveya.example: Avatar of Woe: cards-in-graveyard condition reads only your own graveyard, not all graveyards

condition:condition-count-all-permanents.example: Hour of Revelation: no condition for "ten or more nonland permanents on the battlefield" across all players

condition:condition-lands-same-name.example: Endless Atlas: no condition for 'three or more lands with the same name'

condition:condition-not-casters-turn.example: Scytheclaw Raptor: no intervening-if for 'not the caster's turn' (trigger-object condition reads false at trigger time)

condition:control-distinct-names-count.example: Maze's End: no condition for 'ten or more Gates with different names'

condition:counter-parity-condition.example: Sab-Sunen, Luxa Embodied: can't attack/block unless an even number of counters, and draw if odd: no parity condition over counters

condition:coven.example: Leinore, Autumn Sovereign: no condition for three creatures with different powers (AUTHORING §15)

condition:distinct-names-condition.example: Liliana's Contract: 'four or more Demons with different names' intervening-if: only distinctTokenNames (tokens) exists

condition:dynamic-compare-in-static-filt.example: Champion of Lambholt: 'Creatures with power less than this creature's power can't block creatures you control' — a static's cantBeBlockedBy filter can't compare against the source's live power (an { amount } operand fails closed there).

condition:dynamic-operand-in-intervening.example: Padeem, Consul of Innovation: "If you control the artifact with the greatest mana value" compares with a live maximum, which a trigger's intervening-if can't read.

condition:entered-from-graveyard.example: Kotis, Sibsig Champion: Casting a creature from your graveyard by exiling three other cards (escape would wrongly mark it escaped), and 'entered from a graveyard or was cast from a graveyard'.

condition:equipment-attached-count-condi.example: Brass Knuckles: cast-trigger self copy of a permanent spell and 'two or more Equipment attached' condition

condition:exiled-with-source-count.example: Colfenor's Urn: 'If three or more cards have been exiled with this artifact', then return those cards.

condition:filter-attacking-your-opponent.example: Martial Impetus: no filter for 'creature attacking one of your opponents'

condition:filter-controlled-by-trigger-p.example: Hellkite Tyrant: "You win the game", and "gain control of all artifacts that player controls" — no filter clause names the damaged player.

condition:filter-has-tap-activated-abili.example: Magewright's Stone: no CardFilter clause for 'has an activated ability with {T} in its cost'

condition:filter-same-name-as-source.example: Callidus Assassin: no target filter for 'creature with the same name as this creature'

condition:filter-shares-creature-type-wi.example: Folk Hero: sharesCreatureTypeWith only reads the trigger object, not the granted ability's holder

condition:filter-total-power-toughness.example: Cut Down: no filter for total power plus toughness

condition:filter-x-in-mana-cost.example: Frontline Medic: no battalion trigger; no 'spell with {X} in its mana cost' filter

condition:greatest-power-condition.example: Summon: Fenrir: Chapter II and III.

condition:hand-filter-land-count.example: Anticausal Vestige: A permanent card with mana value up to your land count from hand (BACKLOG).

condition:if-kicked-enters-with-counters.example: Gnarlid Colony: no enters-with-counters conditional on (single) kicker

condition:intervening-if-amounts.example: Liberator, Urza's Battlethopter: 'If the amount of mana spent to cast that spell is greater than Liberator's power' is an intervening-if rechecked on resolution; a condition's `{ amount }` operand fails closed.

condition:intervening-if-not-trigger-pla.example: Price of Glory: no trigger condition for 'if it's not that player's turn' on another player's mana tap

condition:life-above-starting.example: Righteous Valkyrie: 'At least 7 life more than your starting life total'.
condition:life-above-starting.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): life-total takes fixed numbers or half-starting only; no starting life plus N or at least starting life (Righteous Valkyrie, Path of Bravery, Happily Ever After). Already there: engine/src/cards/define.ts life-total condition (lines 768-772, atLeast number, atMost number or half-starting)

condition:linked-exile-currently-exiled.example: Ugin's Labyrinth: needs 'if a card is (currently) exiled with this' mana amount and 'return the exiled card to hand'; exiled-with-source counts ever-exiled

condition:named-artifact-condition.example: Wedding Ring: An opponent gets a copy; triggers on opponents controlling an artifact named Wedding Ring.

condition:no-abilities-filter.example: Ruxa, Patient Professor: no 'creature with no abilities' filter nor optional assign-as-though-unblocked static

condition:no-other-creature-greater-powe.example: Getaway Glamer: 'if no other creature has greater power' condition not expressed

condition:return-cards-put-in-graveyard-.example: Faith's Reward: no filter for cards put into graveyard from the battlefield this turn
condition:return-cards-put-in-graveyard-.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): Turn history records no destination: died covers creatures only, and left covers any zone, so 'put into a graveyard from the battlefield' for non-creature permanents can't be filtered (Faith's Reward, Gerrard, Weatherlight Hero, Twilight Shepherd). Already there: src/state.ts TurnHistory lists died and left, and TurnHistoryEntry (object, count, stint, asEntered: no destination); src/cards/define.ts StaticCondition kind turn-history (what, who, filter, atLeast)

condition:same-name-as-target.example: Maelstrom Pulse: No filter for 'all other permanents with the same name as that permanent'.

condition:shares-creature-type-with-equi.example: Stoneforge Masterwork: sharesCreatureTypeWith only reads a trigger object; no count of creatures sharing a type with the equipped creature.

condition:some-opponent-controls-none.example: Hagra Mauling // Hagra Broodpit: 'Costs {1} less if an opponent controls no basic lands' — one opponent with none.

condition:that-player-controls-more.example: Archaeomancer's Map: "If that player controls more lands than you": opponent-controls-more asks about any opponent, not the one whose land entered.

condition:trigger-condition-casters-turn.example: March of the World Ooze: "if it's not their turn" (the casting opponent's) has no condition; not-your-turn is wrong in multiplayer

condition:turn-count-condition.example: Starting Town: "Unless it's your first, second, or third turn of the game": no per-player count of turns taken.

condition:void-condition.example: Elegy Acolyte: Void (a nonland permanent left the battlefield or a spell was warped this turn) has no StaticCondition.

condition:werewolf-transform-spells-last.example: Duskwatch Recruiter: No condition for spells cast last turn (werewolf transform triggers).

condition:you-have-most-life-trigger-con.example: Preacher of the Schism: second trigger 'attacks while you have the most life or tied' has no condition (first is defenderLife most)

cost:additional-cost-discard-filter.example: Magmatic Insight: additionalCost.discard has no card filter (discard a land card)

cost:additional-cost-reveal.example: Thunderherd Migration: no "reveal a Dinosaur card from your hand" additional-cost option
cost:additional-cost-reveal.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): CardDefinition.additionalCost has no optional reveal-a-card-from-hand option and no 'if you revealed' check: behold is mandatory (Silumgar's Scorn, Scaleguard Sentinels, Thunderherd Migration). Already there: src/cards/define.ts CardDefinition.additionalCost (sacrifice, discard, payLife, waterbend, behold, exileFromGraveyard, options); src/effects.ts BeholdSpec and kind behold (mandatory reveal)

cost:alt-cost-discard-cards.example: Foil: alternative cost 'discard an Island card and another card' isn't expressible

cost:alt-cost-exile-from-hand.example: Commandeer: Gaining control of a spell, and exiling two blue cards as its cost.

cost:alt-cost-opponent-gains-life.example: Invigorate: no alternative cost of having an opponent gain life

cost:alt-cost-pay-life-equal-mana-value.example: Demon of Fate's Design: once-per-turn alternative cost of life equal to mana value, and +X/+0 from the sacrificed enchantment's MV, not expressible together

cost:alt-cost-return-lands.example: Gush: No alternative cost of returning two Islands to hand.

cost:alt-cost-sacrifice.example: Flare of Cultivation: 'Sacrifice a nontoken green creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost', and a two-way search split.

cost:alternative-cost-for-all-spells.example: Leyline of Mutation: leyline opening-hand rule plus WUBRG alt cost for every spell

cost:alternative-cost-for-spells-limits.example: Darksteel Monolith: alternativeCostForSpells has no once-each-turn limit and no cast-from-hand restriction.

cost:alternative-cost-pay-life.example: Snuff Out: 'you may pay 4 life rather than pay this spell's mana cost' if you control a Swamp

cost:attack-tax.example: Propaganda: "Creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {2} for each creature attacking you" — no attack-cost mechanism.
cost:attack-tax.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): attackTax is a fixed generic cost per attacking creature, player only and static: no live count (Sphere of Safety's X per enchantment) and no timed tax that covers planeswalkers (Forbidding Spirit). Already there: src/cards/define.ts StaticAbility.attackTax ({ generic }); src/combat/attacking.ts attackTaxPerCreature

cost:attack-tax-per-counters.example: Nils, Discipline Enforcer: attackTax is a fixed generic amount, not X = counters on the attacking creature, and not covering your planeswalkers

cost:chosen-type-menu-spend-restriction.example: Eclipsed Realms: spendOnly.chosenType reads chooseCreatureTypeOnEnter (any type); no way to limit the menu to the eight listed types

cost:chosen-type-sacrifice-cost.example: Etchings of the Chosen: sacrifice-cost filters are matched with no source, so ofChosenType matches nothing

cost:conditional-alternative-cost.example: Blasphemous Edict: 'You may pay {B} rather than pay this spell's mana cost if there are thirteen or more creatures' — alternativeCost has no condition and always taps creatures; freeCastIf is only free.

cost:cost-increase-not-your-turn.example: Defense Grid: Spells cost more except during their controller's turn.

cost:cost-mod-by-cast-zone.example: Gravebreaker Lamia: costModification can't select spells by the zone they're cast from (graveyard)

cost:cost-modification-by-spell-targets.example: Kasmina, Enigmatic Mentor: can't tax opponents' spells by what they target

cost:cost-move-linked-exiled-card.example: Shelob, Dread Weaver: cost 'put a creature card exiled with Shelob into its owner's graveyard' and X-matched linked-exile target

cost:cost-reduction-creatures-died-this-.example: Blood for the Blood God!: CostReductionAmount has no 'creatures that died this turn' count.

cost:cost-reduction-for-targeting-enchan.example: Strong Back: equip/Aura cost reductions only when targeting the enchanted creature aren't expressible

cost:cost-reduction-greatest-opponent-co.example: Cavern-Hoard Dragon: Costs {X} less where X is the greatest number of artifacts an opponent controls; its combat-damage Treasures count the damaged player's artifacts.

cost:cost-reduction-if-targets.example: Price of Fame: self cost reduction conditioned on the chosen target

cost:cost-reduction-permanents-sacrifice.example: The Balrog, Durin's Bane: no 'permanents sacrificed this turn' cost-reduction count

cost:counter-cost.example: Wall of Roots: Putting a -0/-1 counter on itself as a cost.

cost:creatures-attacked-this-turn-count.example: Rowdy Research: '{1} less for each creature that attacked this turn': no cost-reduction amount counts attackers this turn, including ones no longer on the battlefield (the `attacked` turn stat is only 0/1).

cost:cycling-alt-cost.example: Edge of Autumn: Cycling with a sacrifice-a-land cost has no shape

cost:depletion-counter-lands.example: Hickory Woodlot: enters with depletion counters, sacrifice if none left; no pool precedent

cost:discard-x-cost.example: Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor: 'Discard X cards' as a cost, and a may-pay-life draw per creature.

cost:dynamic-life-cost.example: War Room: "Pay life equal to the number of colors in your commanders' color identity": an activation cost's payLife is a fixed number, and nothing reads the commanders' colour identity.
cost:dynamic-life-cost.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): Hand of Vecna's equip cost of 1 life per card in your hand has no per-card life amount (payLife is a fixed number or commander-identity-colors only). Already there: engine/src/abilities.ts AbilityLifeCost (number | "commander-identity-colors") and abilityLifeCost(); War Room is covered by the commander-identity-colors value. Protection Racket is covered by kind=may costLife (EffectAmount) in engine/src/effects.ts.

cost:equip-ability-cost-reduction.example: Bladehold War-Whip: abilityCostModification can't single out equip abilities of other Equipment.
cost:equip-ability-cost-reduction.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): abilityCostModification's applies filter is on the source permanent and it has no ability-kind selector, so it can't single out equip abilities of other Equipment or equip abilities that target the equipped creature (Fervent Champion, Bladehold War-Whip, Nahiri, Storm of Stone). Already there: src/cards/define.ts StaticAbility.abilityCostModification ({ applies, reduceGeneric, increaseGeneric, leavesOneMana }); src/game.ts abilityCostModificationFor

cost:equip-alternative-costs.example: Gavel of the Righteous: +1/+1 per counter of any kind (grantPtPerCount.countersOnSource takes one kind) and 'Equip—Pay {3} or remove a counter'

cost:equip-cost-per-color.example: Dragonfire Blade: Hexproof from monocolored; equip cost by the target's colors.

cost:exile-creature-cost.example: Food Chain: Exiling a creature as a cost, with mana from its mana value.

cost:exile-many-cost-linked-return.example: Mechtitan Core: exile-five-permanents cost, linked return on token leaving, and all-colors token not expressible

cost:exile-x-cards-cost.example: Necropolis Fiend: 'Exile X cards from your graveyard' as a cost. (Delve is built, 2026-10-02.)

cost:flashback-cost-reduction.example: Visions of Glory: No reduction applying only to the flashback cast by commander mana value (battlefield or command zone).
cost:flashback-cost-reduction.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): No CostReductionAmount counts the commander's mana value in the command zone or battlefield, so the flashback reduction by commander mana value can't be written (Visions of Duplicity, Visions of Dread, Visions of Glory). Already there: src/cards/define.ts CardDefinition.selfCostReduction ({ condition, reduceGeneric: CostReductionAmount }, from any zone); src/abilities.ts CostReductionAmount

cost:flashback-exile-x-cost.example: Summons of Saruman: Flashback cost 'Exile X cards from your graveyard' and casting a free spell from among the milled cards aren't expressible.

cost:free-cast-from-hand-static.example: Omniscience: 'You may cast spells from your hand without paying their mana costs': alternativeCostForSpells can't be limited to the hand, and a card with an alternative cost of its own would be offered only that one.
cost:free-cast-from-hand-static.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): alternativeCostForSpells cannot be limited to spells cast from hand (Omniscience, Omnipresence) and cannot be granted to every player or give flash (Aluren). Already there: engine/src/cards/define.ts alternativeCostForSpells { mana, filter? } (controller's spells only), read in engine/src/game.ts (alternativeCostForSpells static grant, around line 32864).

cost:free-cast-once-each-turn.example: As Foretold: 'Once each turn, you may pay {0} rather than pay the mana cost' for spells up to its time counters.
cost:free-cast-once-each-turn.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): As Foretold's cast is limited to spells up to the exiled card's time counters, and its {0} option is not confirmed to match impulse-exile free without the 'only' flag. Already there: engine/src/effects.ts kind=impulse-exile fields free, oncePerTurn, whileSource, duration ("while-source"), plus the countersOn amount in effects.ts for the counter count.

cost:kicker-nonmana-cost.example: Primal Growth: kicker cost is a sacrifice; kicker.cost is mana only
cost:kicker-nonmana-cost.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): A kicker that is a filtered sacrifice (Goblin Barrage: an artifact or Goblin; Vicious Offering: a creature) is not expressible; the only non-mana kicker sacrifice is bargain's fixed artifact, enchantment or token. Already there: engine/src/cards/define.ts kicker.keyword "bargain" (fixed sacrifice filter); kicker.cost is a mana string.

cost:loyalty-x.example: Tezzeret the Seeker: A −X loyalty ability.

cost:mana-restriction-cast-from-graveyar.example: Lord of the Forsaken: Mana spendable only to cast a spell from your graveyard: a mana restriction can't ask the spell's zone.

cost:mana-spend-only-x-costs.example: Nexos: no ManaRestriction for 'only on costs that contain {X}'
cost:mana-spend-only-x-costs.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): Rosheen's 'spend only on costs that contain {X}' cannot reach activated abilities (ManaRestriction.abilityOf takes permanents only), and Drain Life's 'spend only black mana on X' has no restriction limited to the X part of a cost. Already there: engine/src/mana.ts ManaRestriction.spell (CardFilter) and engine/src/filter.ts xInManaCost for spells with {X}.

cost:mill-cost.example: Millikin: '{T}, Mill a card: Add {C}' — milling as a cost.

cost:minus-zero-minus-one-counters.example: Wall of Roots: Putting a -0/-1 counter on itself as a cost.

cost:multiple-alternative-costs.example: Dracogenesis: An alternative cost for Dragon spells; with Jodah, Archmage Eternal out too, the engine offers only the first alternative cost it finds rather than the player's choice.

cost:optional-life-additional-cost-for-s.example: Defiler of Dreams: optional pay-2-life additional cost reducing {U} on other spells not expressible

cost:pay-any-amount-of-energy.example: Aether Refinery: No replacement on getting {E}, and no 'pay one or more {E}' with X = amount paid.

effect:counter-all-spells.example: Reverse the Polarity: no 'counter all other spells' and no switch-P/T-of-all-creatures effect

effect:counter-each-unless-pays.example: Whirlwind Denial: counter each opposing spell and ability unless paid has no shape

effect:counter-exile-instead.example: Force of Negation: The not-your-turn alternative cost exiles a blue card from hand, and "exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard" isn't an option on counter.

effect:counter-into-exile-suspend.example: Delay: Countering into exile with time counters and suspend.

effect:counter-to-library-top.example: Memory Lapse: counter's 'into' is hand or exile only, not top of library

effect:counters-equal-power-minus-base-p.example: Sovereign Okinec Ahau: no per-creature amount for power minus base power in add-counter-all

effect:counters-put-this-turn-stat.example: Iridescent Hornbeetle: no turn stat for +1/+1 counters you've put on creatures this turn

effect:counters-put-this-way.example: Fangs of Kalonia: 'each creature that had a counter put on it this way' has no thisWay kind (overload half)

effect:create-token-attach-equipment.example: Fractal Harness: X counters on the created token and attach this Equipment to it; double counters on attack

effect:created-token-reference.example: Feldon of the Third Path: 'It gains haste' on the token copy is not a copy exception (a copy of the token doesn't get it), and nothing names the token created.

effect:damage-dealt-this-way.example: Creeping Bloodsucker: 'Gain life equal to the damage dealt this way' needs the damage actually dealt (Torbran, prevention), which no amount reads.

effect:damage-from-attached.example: Pain for All: the Aura's enters trigger has the enchanted creature deal damage to 'any other target'; DamageFrom has no 'attached' source and no target excluding the host

effect:damage-from-target.example: Chandra's Ignition: The targeted creature must be the source of the damage to each other creature and each opponent; damage-all/damage only deal damage from the resolving spell (or a trigger object).

effect:damage-to-trigger-object.example: Caltrops: no untargeted damage to the attacking creature (damage takes only a target slot)

effect:defending-player-chooses-from-you.example: Drana, the Last Bloodchief: the defending player chooses a creature card from your graveyard, which then enters with a counter

effect:defending-player-of-attached-atta.example: Captain America's Shield: 'target creature defending player controls' reads the ability source's attack; an Equipment's source isn't attacking, so the slot has no legal targets

effect:delayed-count-still-exiled.example: Dragonhawk, Fate's Tempest: At your next end step, 2 damage to each opponent for each card exiled this way that's still exiled; nothing tracks which of them remain.

effect:delayed-life-gain-trigger.example: Vizkopa Guildmage: 'whenever you gain life this turn' delayed trigger not expressible

effect:delayed-trigger-each-combat.example: Full Throttle: Two additional combat phases after this main phase, and 'at the beginning of each combat this turn, untap all creatures that attacked this turn'.

effect:delayed-trigger-on-targeted-creat.example: Long River Lurker: this-turn trigger on the targeted creature's combat damage; ward granted to other Frogs

effect:delayed-trigger-rest-of-turn.example: Massacre Girl: 'Whenever a creature dies this turn, each creature other than Massacre Girl gets -1/-1' — a delayed trigger that repeats for the rest of the turn.

effect:destroy-all-except-source.example: Elspeth Tirel: destroy-all has no exceptSource; 'other permanents' would destroy Elspeth herself
effect:destroy-all-except-source.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): destroy-all has no exceptSource (damage-all, exile-all and modify-pt-all have one), so 'destroy all other creatures' (Elspeth Tirel, Novablast Wurm, Magister of Worth) can't leave the source out. Already there: effects.ts kind destroy-all (filter, controlledByTarget, onlyControllersDamagedBySource, cantBeRegenerated); exceptSource on damage-all (effects.ts ~1830)

effect:discard-batch-exile-one-cast.example: Conspiracy Theorist: 'exile one of them [the discarded nonland cards], you may cast it this turn' can't choose from the discard batch

effect:discard-chosen-from-revealed-hand.example: Duress: discard has no 'you choose a [filtered] card from their revealed hand' form

effect:discard-or-sacrifice-choice.example: Eumidian Wastewaker: "You and defending player each discard a card or sacrifice a permanent": a forced per-player choice between a discard and a sacrifice (only the possible one offered), you then the defending player, done together, then co

effect:discard-shortfall-per-opponent.example: Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal: 'for each opponent who can't [discard], you draw' has no shape; also transforms on death into a land face

effect:discard-unless-land.example: Compulsive Research: Discard two cards unless they discard a land card.

effect:discarded-card-type-condition.example: Vohar, Vodalian Desecrator: grant-graveyard-cast has no 'exile it instead' replacement; no 'if you discarded an instant or sorcery this way' gate on a loot

effect:distinct-names-count.example: All-Fates Scroll: Only distinctTokenNames exists; no count of differently named lands.

effect:distribute-counters.example: Abzan Charm: distributing two +1/+1 counters among one or two targets isn't built (AUTHORING §15)
effect:distribute-counters.description: Not: untargeted chosen recipients or a variable total (effect:distribute-counters-among-chosen, effect:distribute-counters-variable-total), a Saga chapter (effect:saga-chapter-divided).

effect:divided-damage-trigger.example: Inferno Titan: '3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets' on a triggered ability: division is built for spells only (AUTHORING §15).

effect:divided-dynamic-total.example: Monstrous Onslaught: 'X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control as you cast this spell' — divided.total is a fixed number.
effect:divided-dynamic-total.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): A divided total read from a game value at cast or activation (Monstrous Onslaught's greatest power, Ravenous Gigantotherium's own power): divided.total is a fixed number, or X for a spell only Already there: src/cards/define.ts CardDefinition.divided {total, slot, x}; src/abilities.ts divided (fixed total; byTriggerValue/byTurnStat for triggers only); src/effects.ts case damage-divided

effect:doesnt-untap-next-all.example: Tangle: doesntUntapNext exists only on single-target tap; nothing marks every attacking creature without tapping it

effect:doesnt-untap-next-untap-step.example: Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger: 'That land doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step'.

effect:domain-count.example: Scion of Draco: no domain (basic land types among lands) amount, and no colour-conditional keyword grants per creature

effect:double-life-total.example: Beacon of Immortality: gain-life can't target a player or double a (possibly negative) life total

effect:double-mana-pool.example: Doubling Cube: No effect doubles each type of unspent mana in the pool.

effect:double-power-each.example: Thrakkus the Butcher: double-pt-all doubles toughness too; no per-permanent 'double the power of each' effect

effect:double-x-on-cast.example: Unbound Flourishing: Doubling X of a permanent spell as cast, and copying an activated ability whose cost contains {X}.

effect:draw-controller-of-target.example: Introduction to Annihilation: "Its controller draws a card": draw has no controller-of-target recipient (only who scope or a player target slot)

effect:drawn-this-way-count.example: Communal Brewing: no amount for 'each card drawn this way', and 'any number of target opponents each draw' plus counters on the cast creature weren't verified

effect:drawn-this-way-trigger.example: Explosion of Riches: 'Whenever a card is drawn this way', 5 damage to an opponent chosen at random.

effect:each-creature-damages-itself.example: Wave of Reckoning: no effect where each creature deals damage to itself equal to its power

effect:each-opponent-exiles-choice.example: Olórin's Searing Light: no 'each opponent exiles a creature of their choice' effect with per-player LKI power damage
effect:each-opponent-exiles-choice.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): The affected player's own choice exists only for sacrifice (each affected player sacrifices N of their choice); no exile-by-choice of the affected player's permanent (Debt to the Kami, Doomfall, Olorin's Searing Light); choose-permanents is picked by the effect's controller. Already there: engine/src/effects.ts sacrifice (who, filter, count, affected player chooses); engine/src/effects.ts choose-permanents (effect controller picks); engine/src/effects.ts exile (target only)

effect:each-opponent-who-cant-discard.example: Entropic Battlecruiser: Attack trigger's 'each opponent who can't [discard] loses 3 life' has no per-player could-not-discard branch.

effect:each-permanent-deals-damage.example: Sarkhan the Masterless: 'each Dragon you control deals 1 damage to that creature' (one source per Dragon) has no effect

effect:each-player-chooses-counters-then.example: Agitator Ant: each player chooses a creature in turn, then counters land together and only those that got counters are goaded

effect:each-player-chooses-creature-type.example: Patriarch's Bidding: Each player chooses a creature type, in turn order, and each returns creature cards of any chosen type at once; choose-creature-type asks only the resolving player.

effect:each-player-chooses-destroy-rest.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): destroy every permanent not chosen after each player chooses (Urza's Sylex, Fortunate Few); sacrifice-all-but only sacrifices Already there: engine/src/effects.ts kind sacrifice-all-but (~line 5335), with who, keep, filter, upTo

effect:each-player-chooses-in-turn-order.example: The Legend of Yangchen: chapter I 'starting with you, each player chooses up to one permanent' has no vocabulary; same transform-return ruling gap

effect:each-player-chooses-then-all-act.example: Perforating Artist: each opponent chooses in turn order, then all the actions happen at once (ruling); each-player-may does each player's before asking the next (docs/engine-gaps.md)
effect:each-player-chooses-then-all-act.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): applying the chosen effects together after every choice is made (Perforating Artist, Innocent Traveler, Decoy Gambit); each-player-may applies each player's follow-up in turn Already there: engine/src/effects.ts kind each-player-may with ifDid/ifDidnt and resultsFor (~line 5240-5300)

effect:each-player-may-counters-protecti.example: Noble Heritage: each-player optional counters plus protection from a player until your next turn not expressible

effect:each-player-may-feasibility.example: Charismatic Conqueror: 'They may tap that permanent. If they don't, you create a token' — the ruling says they can't choose to tap one that's already tapped or gone, but each-player-may offers its effect regardless.

effect:each-player-returns-own-permanent.example: Curfew / Umbilicus: each player chooses one of their own permanents to return to hand — choose-permanents asks the effect's controller.

effect:each-player-search.example: Veteran Explorer: search-library can't be run by each player in turn ('that-player').

effect:edict-fallback-per-player.example: Plaguecrafter: 'Each player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker. Each player who can't discards a card' — no per-player fallback on an edict.

effect:effect-on-enchanted-permanent.example: Redemption Arc: no EffectTargetRef for an Aura's enchanted creature, so '{1}{W}: Exile enchanted creature' can't be written

effect:emblem-free-cast-from-hand.example: Tamiyo, Field Researcher: Delayed combat-damage watch is to-player and this-turn only (Tamiyo's is any combat damage until your next turn); emblem 'cast spells from hand without paying' unmodeled.

effect:emblem-grants-activated.example: Liliana of the Dark Realms: +X/+X or -X/-X chosen as it resolves, and an emblem granting Swamps an ability.

effect:emblem-grants-to-spells.example: Ral, Crackling Wit: Rechecked: the -10's emblem grants storm to spells, but spell grants are read only off battlefield permanents, never an emblem.

effect:emblem-instant-speed-loyalty.example: Teferi, Temporal Archmage: -10 emblem lets loyalty abilities be activated at instant speed on any turn; no static for it

effect:emblem-static-abilities.example: Tamiyo, the Moon Sage: an emblem's static other than a creatures-you-control anthem ('You have no maximum hand size') — read by its rule only off battlefield permanents (AUTHORING §15). The triggered half is built (2026-10-09).

bug:token-copy-skips-as-enters-choices.example: Nexus of Becoming: the token copy of the exiled card must be asked its as-enters choices (ruling); Ardyn, Yenna, Rebuild the City, Kindred Charge, Ember Island Production and Abyssal Harvester wait on the same.
bug:token-copy-skips-as-enters-choices.description: create-token-copy never runs the copied card's "as this enters" choices (chooseOnEnter, copyOnEnter, a chosen creature type, riot): a token copy enters with nothing chosen, though the rulings say those abilities work (AUTHORING §15). Needs the copy made off the battlefield, asked, and the rest of the resolution resumed.

condition:defender-no-opponent-more-life.example: Sword Coast Sailor: 'attacks a player, if no opponent has more life than that player' (also Hardy Outlander, Agent of the Shadow Thieves, Guild Artisan, Veteran Soldier).
condition:defender-no-opponent-more-life.description: An attack condition: no opponent of the attacking player has more life than the defending player (ties allowed, the attacker's own life left out). DefenderLife's "most" counts every player, the attacker included.

bug:simultaneous-move-with-choice.example: Avatar Destiny: returns itself and the chosen milled creature card together.
bug:simultaneous-move-with-choice.description: A simultaneous move that needs a choice first: a `simultaneous` sequence can't hold a step that asks, so 'return this card and up to one creature card milled this way' becomes two leave events.

bug:simultaneous-discards.example: Burning Inquiry: each player discards three at random, all at the same time (ruling). Noggle Ransacker, in the pool, has the same gap without a ruling saying so.
bug:simultaneous-discards.description: Every player's discard from one instruction is one event: ctx.simultaneously batches battlefield and graveyard leaves and entries and damage, not hand-to-graveyard moves.

bug:mana-value-of-countered-copy.example: Deekah, Fractal Theorist: a copied spell's mana value when the copy is countered in response.
bug:mana-value-of-countered-copy.description: A spell copy is deleted as it leaves the stack, so manaValueOf a copy countered in response reads 0; lastStackManaValue covers real cards only. Same root as bug:controller-of-target-countered-copy.

filter:enchanted-by-another-aura.example: Daybreak Coronet: 'Enchant creature with another Aura attached to it'.
filter:enchanted-by-another-aura.description: An enchant or target filter for a creature with another Aura attached (not counting the Aura itself): CardFilter.enchanted is a yes/no that counts the Aura once attached.

bug:moved-target-card-still-acted-on.example: Celestial Gatekeeper: targeting itself, it is exiled by the first step and must stay exiled (ruling), but is returned.
bug:moved-target-card-still-acted-on.description: A targeted card moved by an earlier step of the same resolution is a new object (rules 400.7, 608.2b): put-onto-battlefield on a graveyard-card target still acts on it from its new zone.

bug:reflexive-target-compare-bound-at-cr.example: Auron, Venerated Guardian: shrinking Auron in response must make a target with power not less than its power illegal.
bug:reflexive-target-compare-bound-at-cr.description: A reflexive trigger's target filter comparing with a live amount (power less than the source's) is bound to a number when the trigger is created (bindDynamicCompares), so the resolution recheck reads a stale value.

static:pt-per-attachments-on-source.example: Kellan, the Fae-Blooded: 'other creatures you control get +1/+0 for each Aura and Equipment attached to Kellan'.
static:pt-per-attachments-on-source.description: A static P/T bonus per Aura and Equipment attached to the static's own source: grantPtPerCount's attachedTo matches a host only by filter and can't name the source.

effect:emblem-no-max-hand-size.example: Wrenn and Seven: maxHandSizeOf reads only battlefield statics, so the −8 emblem's 'no maximum hand size' wouldn't apply

effect:emblem-play-from-graveyard.example: Wrenn and Realmbreaker: play permissions are read only from battlefield sources, so the -7 emblem's playFromGraveyard wouldn't work

effect:enters-under-opponent-control.example: Xantcha, Sleeper Agent: no 'enters under the control of an opponent of your choice', 'can't attack its owner', or 'any player may activate'
effect:enters-under-opponent-control.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): A permanent entering itself under an opponent's control (Captive Audience, Xantcha's chosen opponent) and exile-then-return under an opponent (Sol'Kanar): put-onto-battlefield's under works only for a card an effect puts onto the battlefield, and flicker has no under. Already there: effects.ts put-onto-battlefield under (EffectPlayerRef, includes that-player) after choose-opponent (effects.ts case choose-opponent); define.ts CombatRestriction cant-attack-owner; src/cards/pool/flailing-manticore.ts anyPlayer

effect:enters-with-counters-dynamic.example: Banner of Kinship: Enters with a fellowship counter per creature of the chosen type, and chosen-type creatures get +1/+1 per counter on the Banner — enters-with counters are fixed and grantPtPerCount can't count the source's counters.

effect:excess-damage-amount.example: Hell to Pay: no amount for excess damage dealt this way

effect:excess-damage-to-controller.example: Ravenous Tyrannosaurus: no devour; no excess-damage redirection to the creature's controller

effect:exchange-control.example: Volatile Stormdrake: Exchange of control, energy upkeep, and hexproof from activated and triggered abilities.
effect:exchange-control.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): No exchange-control effect. Two gain-control steps with who controllerOfTarget read the controllers live, so the second may read the first's new controller unless both are read before either moves; not confirmed (Modify Memory, Visions of Duplicity). Already there: effects.ts kind gain-control with who controllerOfTarget (EffectPlayerRef); sequence simultaneous (effects.ts case sequence)

effect:exchange-control-all-with-target-.example: Reins of Power: no mutual control swap of all creatures with one target opponent

effect:exchange-life-toughness.example: Tree of Perdition: Exchanging a life total with toughness.

effect:exile-all-linked.example: Worldgorger Dragon: exile-all has no linked/exiledWith option for 'return the exiled cards' (and must exile even if the Dragon already left)

effect:exile-all-target-player-scope.example: Settle the Wreckage: exile-all can't be scoped to a targeted player's permanents, nor search 'that many' for that player

effect:exile-any-number-until-leaves.example: Glorious Protector: choose any number of non-Angels to exile until it leaves, plus foretell

effect:exile-cast-free-from-look.example: The Key to the Vault: Exile a nonland card from the looked-at cards to cast free.

effect:exile-self-on-resolve.example: Rise of the Eldrazi: 'Exile Rise of the Eldrazi' as it resolves.

effect:exile-top-put-matching.example: Tezzeret, Master of the Bridge: -8 exiles ten then puts the artifacts among them onto the battlefield; put-exiled-this-way has no filter and look-and-choose has no exile leftover

effect:exile-transform-return.example: Urabrask // The Great Work: Its transform ability and The Great Work's chapter III.

effect:exile-until-leaves-per-opponent.example: Bronzebeak Foragers: per-opponent O-Ring group plus targeting a card exiled with it by mana value X

effect:exile-until-opponent-becomes-mona.example: Palace Jailer: no 'until an opponent becomes the monarch' exile duration

effect:exile-until-other-target-leaves.example: Calix, Destiny's Hand: -3 exiles until a different target enchantment leaves; no such duration.

effect:exiled-card-gains-trigger.example: Cosima, God of the Voyage: Exiled card gaining a landfall trigger with voyage counters and a return is not expressible.

effect:exiled-this-way-to-graveyard.example: Glimpse the Impossible: Remaining exiled cards go to the graveyard at the next end step.

effect:exiled-with-source-to-graveyard.example: Valakut Exploration: 'If there are cards exiled with this enchantment, put them into their owner's graveyard, then deal that much damage'.

effect:extra-combat-attack-restriction.example: Bumi, Unleashed: No way to say only land creatures can attack during the added combat phase.

effect:fame-or-fortune.example: Seize the Spotlight: Each opponent chooses fame or fortune.

effect:first-creature-spell-flash.example: Radagast of Rhosgobel: castAsThoughFlash can't be limited to your first creature spell each turn

effect:flash-cast-sacrifice.example: Necromancy: Becomes an Aura with 'enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Necromancy' and attaches to the returned creature; and the cleanup sacrifice only when cast at instant timing.

effect:flash-for-each-player.example: Tidal Barracuda: castAsThoughFlash grants only to the controller, not any player

effect:flash-for-extra-cost.example: Saproling Symbiosis: 'Cast as though it had flash if you pay {2} more' has no vocabulary.
effect:flash-for-extra-cost.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): No optional extra cost that grants flash to a non-kicker spell (Rout, Oakshade Stalker, Saproling Symbiosis); the only route is kicker with flash:true, which marks the spell kicked. Already there: engine/src/cards/define.ts kicker flash?: boolean (~2651, kicked variant may be cast as though it had flash); engine/src/game.ts kicked && def.kicker?.flash checks (~11689, ~28434)

effect:flash-if-targets-commander.example: Timely Ward: 'As though it had flash if it targets a commander'.

effect:flash-permission-this-turn.example: Emergence Zone: 'You may cast spells this turn as though they had flash' — castAsThoughFlash is a static, with no one-shot this-turn form.

effect:flicker-counters-by-type.example: Semester's End: A flicker return takes one counter kind; needs +1/+1 if creature and loyalty if planeswalker, read as it returns.

effect:flicker-return-then.example: Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd: 'If it entered under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on Phelia' after the delayed return.

effect:gain-control-spell.example: Commandeer: Gaining control of a spell, and exiling two blue cards as its cost.

effect:gain-lose-all-creature-types.example: Amoeboid Changeling: no effect to gain or lose all creature types until end of turn

effect:grant-mana-ability-to-countered-c.example: Jiang Yanggu, Wildcrafter: granting a mana ability to creatures with a +1/+1 counter; not found under time limit

effect:grant-protection-choice.example: Giver of Runes: 'Gains protection from colorless or from the color of your choice' — protection chosen on resolution.
effect:grant-protection-choice.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): Protection chosen as the effect resolves, or granted for a duration (Giver of Runes, Radiant, Sanctuary Blade): protection exists only as a fixed printed static, and grant-keyword takes Keyword values, which has no protection. Already there: engine/src/cards/define.ts StaticAbility protection (~line 2079: colors, types, filter, fixed when printed); engine/src/effects.ts grant-keyword (~line 3378)

effect:grant-static-to-permanent.example: The Book of Exalted Deeds: No effect granting a target a static 'can't lose / opponents can't win' ability
effect:grant-static-to-permanent.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): An effect granting a target permanent a static ability (Book of Exalted Deeds' can't-lose static); Aura and Equipment statics of their own work (Earthbind's loses flying via loseKeywords), but Joven's Tools also needs the blocker filter from cant-be-blocked-by-filter-until-eot. Already there: engine/src/cards/define.ts StaticAbility loseKeywords (layer 6, on the attached object); engine/src/effects.ts restrict (cant-be-blocked)

effect:grant-trigger-pump-sharing-creatu.example: Haunted One: granted becomes-tapped trigger pumping 'it and others sharing a creature type' plus undying EOT has no precedent shape

effect:greatest-among-discarded.example: Scythe Specter: Each player who discarded a card with the greatest mana value among cards discarded this way loses life equal to it.

effect:hand-mana-ability.example: Simian Spirit Guide: "Exile this card from your hand: Add {R}" — a mana ability activated from hand, exiling itself; zone abilities are never mana abilities and a hand ability discards.

effect:hidden-simultaneous-choices.example: Professor Onyx: −8: each opponent chooses a card hidden, then all are discarded at once (its ruling); each-player-may asks openly, one at a time.
effect:hidden-simultaneous-choices.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): The hidden, held choice exists only inside each-player-may (holdChoices until the last player chooses); a mandatory each-player discard (Geier Reach) resolves per player in turn order, and each-opponent choose-a-card-hidden-then-discard-all (Professor Onyx) has no form. Already there: engine/src/effects.ts applyEachPlayerMay (ctx.holdChoices / releaseHeldChoices, ~7757-7760); engine/src/effects.ts discard case (each-player discards one by one via discardCards)

effect:impulse-exile-for-creature-contro.example: Gonti, Night Minister: 'a spell they don't own' is judged against the caster (ownedBy is relative to Gonti's controller), and the face-down exile/permission goes to each damaging creature's controller, not Gonti's

effect:instant-speed-loyalty.example: Teferi, Master of Time: Loyalty abilities at instant speed, and phasing.
effect:instant-speed-loyalty.description: A permanent's own static only; granted until end of turn is effect:grant-instant-speed-loyalty-until-eot.

effect:keep-one-of-each-permanent-type.example: Liliana, Dreadhorde General: −9: each opponent keeps one permanent of each permanent type (a multi-typed one counting for any) and sacrifices the rest.

effect:leaves-act-on-permanent-put-there.example: Diabolic Servitude: its leaves-the-battlefield trigger exiles 'the creature put onto the battlefield with this' — putThereBySource compares against the live source, which has left.

effect:legendary-sorcery.example: Jaya's Immolating Inferno: The legendary sorcery casting restriction (rule 205.4e).

effect:library-third-from-top.example: Ilharg, the Raze-Boar: hand creature onto battlefield tapped and attacking with an end-step return of that creature, and 'third from the top' on death/exile

effect:life-total-becomes.example: Shaman of Forgotten Ways: No effect sets a life total ('each player's life total becomes the number of creatures they control')
effect:life-total-becomes.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): No effect sets a life total (Shaman of Forgotten Ways, Torgaar, Captive Audience); emulating it with gain-life or lose-life of the difference would fire life-change triggers and replacements the rules don't. Already there: engine/src/effects.ts gain-life and lose-life with an EffectAmount; amount difference with absolute (digest Amounts section); amount lifeTotal

effect:linked-exile-from-discard.example: Currency Converter: exiling a discarded card linked to the artifact, then moving a chosen linked card with a land/nonland branch, isn't expressible

effect:linked-exile-return.example: Sothera, the Supervoid: each opponent chooses and exiles (not sacrifices), linked to Sothera, then returns one with extra counters

effect:linked-exile-token-copy.example: Mimic Vat: Token copy of a card exiled with it, and returning each other linked card to the graveyard: neither exists.

effect:linked-exiled-card.example: Skyclave Apparition: The leaves-the-battlefield ability reads 'the exiled card' its enters ability exiled for good (its owner and mana value): no link from a source to a card it exiled permanently.

effect:linked-token-leaves.example: Ugin, the Ineffable: +1 exiles a card face down that only you may look at, and 'when that token leaves the battlefield, put the exiled card into your hand' links the card to the token.
effect:linked-token-leaves.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): An exile linked to a created token and returned when that token leaves (Ugin, the Ineffable's +1): the exile links to the ability's source, not the token Already there: src/effects.ts exile untilSourceLeaves and linked; src/effects.ts return-exiled-by-source (linked hand)

effect:look-and-choose-enters-with-count.example: Elspeth Resplendent: −3 puts the chosen permanent onto the battlefield WITH a shield counter; look-and-choose has no withCounters (a `then` add-counter would be put on after it enters).

effect:target-creature-source-is-blockin.example: Tinder Wall: "Target creature it's blocking" has no target spec.
effect:target-creature-source-is-blockin.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): The target relation 'creature it's blocking' (Tinder Wall) and the blocked-by side for Sentinel and Lesser Werewolf: only a generic blocking filter exists, with no link to the source. Already there: src/filter.ts blocking?: boolean (~line 255); src/target.ts permanent target kind (~line 137)

effect:target-different-controllers.example: Run Away Together: Two target creatures controlled by different players.

effect:target-in-that-players-graveyard.example: Goblin Welder: A second target 'in that player's graveyard', tied to the first target's controller, swapped simultaneously.

effect:target-opponent-chooses.example: Combustible Gearhulk: 'Target opponent may have you draw three cards. If the player doesn't, you mill three cards, then … damage equal to the total mana value of those cards' — a choice by a targeted opponent between two of your effects.
effect:target-opponent-chooses.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): An opponent choosing one of their own permanents for a non-sacrifice effect (Sakashima's Will, Hunted Nightmare): choose-permanents is the controller's choice, and look-and-choose's chooser reaches only public zones. Already there: src/cards/pool/combustible-gearhulk.ts: each-player-may with who controllerOfTarget 0 (the targeted opponent's may-choice, effects.ts each-player-may)

effect:target-per-opponent.example: Grasp of Fate: 'For each opponent, exile up to one target nonland permanent that player controls.'

effect:target-player-becomes-monarch.example: Éomer, King of Rohan: become-monarch takes only a scope, not a target player
effect:target-player-becomes-monarch.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): become-monarch takes a PlayerScope, which has no target player slot, so a targeted opponent cannot become the monarch and 'you can't become it this turn' has no field (Jared Carthalion, Eomer, M'Baku) Already there: src/effects.ts kind 'become-monarch' (who?: PlayerScope, via?) and type PlayerScope (line ~1016)

effect:target-player-searches.example: Varragoth, Bloodsky Sire: Boast, and a target player's search to the top of their library.

effect:target-player-shuffles-graveyard-.example: Primal Command: no effect for a target player shuffling their graveyard into their library

effect:target-spell-cant-be-countered.example: Vexing Shusher: No effect making a target spell uncounterable.

effect:target-spell-or-ability.example: Voidslime: no target spec covering a spell or an activated/triggered ability in one slot

effect:target-spell-that-targets-you.example: Dawn Charm: 'counter target spell that targets you'

effect:targets-equal-toughness.example: V.A.T.S.: no target-group rule requiring equal toughness

effect:targets-from-single-graveyard.example: Unlicensed Hearse: No 'up to two targets from a single graveyard' relation, nor a P/T CDA counting cards exiled with it.
effect:targets-from-single-graveyard.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): A same-graveyard constraint across the chosen targets (Unlicensed Hearse, Pestilent Cauldron, Waste Management): any-number over card-in-graveyard exists, but nothing requires every chosen card to come from one graveyard. Already there: src/target.ts any-number (~line 312) with card-in-graveyard (~line 180)

effect:targets-from-target-players-grave.example: Quandrix Command: mode 4's 'up to three target cards from their graveyard' can't bind card targets to the target player's graveyard
effect:targets-from-target-players-grave.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): A card-in-graveyard target tied to the graveyard of a target player slot (Witness the Future, Quandrix Command, Stream of Consciousness): whose takes a seat or a relative such as opponent, not a player target. Already there: src/target.ts card-in-graveyard whose (~line 192) with any-number (~line 312)

effect:targets-modified-permanent.example: Pearl-Ear, Imperial Advisor: Enchantment spells with affinity for Auras; a trigger on an Aura targeting a modified permanent.

effect:targets-share-type.example: Secret Tunnel: 'Two target creatures you control that share a creature type' — a constraint across the targets.

effect:targets-with-different-names.example: Behold the Sinister Six!: No target-group constraint for 'with different names'.

effect:temporary-token-doubling.example: Kaya, Geist Hunter: −2: token doubling until end of turn — only static doublers exist.

effect:text-change-creature-type-words.example: New Blood: replacing a creature-type word across the creature's rules text isn't modeled (change-text only swaps a type-line word from a menu)

effect:token-attacks-if-able.example: Legion Warboss: Mentor, and a created token that attacks this combat if able.

effect:token-copy-count-amount.example: For the Common Good: X token copies: create-token-copy's count is a fixed number.
effect:token-copy-count-amount.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): An amount for create-token-copy's count (Rionya, Devastating Onslaught): count is a fixed number. Already there: src/effects.ts create-token-copy count: number (~line 4600)

effect:token-copy-enters-with-counters.example: Ochre Jelly: Split: the delayed token copy enters with half the dead creature's +1/+1 counters

effect:token-copy-for-each-matching.example: Second Harvest: 'For each token you control, create a token that's a copy of that permanent' — create-token-copy copies one named object.

effect:token-copy-of-exiled-card.example: Mardu Siegebreaker: token copies of a linked exiled card, tapped and attacking each opponent, not expressible
effect:token-copy-of-exiled-card.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): A token copy of a linked exiled card as a cost or effect result (Mardu Siegebreaker, Tawnos, Dollhouse of Horrors): create-token-copy's of takes source, trigger-object, entered-together, equipped, a number, or each, with no linked-exile option. Already there: src/effects.ts create-token-copy of (~line 4599) with tapped and attacking fields

effect:token-copy-of-graveyard-cards.example: Grist, Voracious Larva: Back face −6 copies graveyard creature cards as 1/1 Insects, +1 needs a milled-black-card condition for the deathtouch counter

effect:token-enters-blocking.example: Brimaz, King of Oreskos: create-token has 'attacking' but no 'blocking that creature'

effect:token-per-object-fights.example: Ezuri's Predation: One 4/4 token per creature your opponents control, each fighting a different one of those creatures, simultaneously — nothing pairs created tokens with the objects they were made for.

effect:token-with-amount-pt.example: Quartzwood Crasher: An X/X token where X is the damage dealt.

effect:tokens-become-copies.example: Brudiclad, Telchor Engineer: Each other token becomes a copy of a chosen token.

effect:tokens-created-with-source.example: Faerie Artisans: no tracking of 'all other tokens created with this creature' to exile

effect:tokens-entered-this-turn-copies.example: Renewed Solidarity: A copy of each token of the chosen type that entered this turn, at end step.

effect:total-mana-value-cast-this-turn.example: Call Forth the Tempest: Damage equal to the total mana value of other spells cast this turn, beside two cascades.

effect:transform-all.example: Moonmist: no mass transform effect ('transform all Humans')

effect:turn-scoped-mana-trigger.example: High Tide: "Until end of turn, whenever a player taps an Island for mana" — a triggered mana ability for every player that lasts the turn, Islands entering later included.

effect:turn-stat-cards-discarded.example: The Raven Man: no turn-stat for 'a player discarded a card this turn'

effect:turn-stat-cards-to-graveyard.example: Welcome the Dead: X is the cards put into your graveyard from your hand or library this turn.

effect:turn-stat-counters-put.example: Lasting Tarfire: no turn stat for 'you put a counter on a creature this turn'

effect:turn-stat-per-player-amount.example: Wound Reflection: Each opponent loses the life they lost this turn — an amount read per opponent.

effect:tutor-to-nth-from-top.example: Long-Term Plans: search-library can put the find on top, not third from the top

effect:two-players-search.example: Scheming Symmetry: Two target players each search and put a card on top.

effect:unattach-effect.example: Akiri, Fearless Voyager: Unattaching an Equipment as an effect.
effect:unattach-effect.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): Disarm's 'unattach every Equipment attached to target creature': unattach takes one target, no mass form Already there: src/effects.ts kind "unattach" (target) and its case at ~line 10987; used by src/cards/pool/acquisition-octopus.ts

effect:unless-if-they-do.example: Don't Make a Sound: The 'unless' effect has no 'if they do' (surveil 2 when paid).

effect:unless-pay-energy.example: Rush of Inspiration: "Discard a card at random unless you pay {E}{E}" — unless options can't pay energy (MDFC back face Crackling Falls deleted with it).

effect:unless-return-permanent.example: Karoo: No 'sacrifice it unless you return an untapped Plains' option (unless options lack a return-to-hand).

effect:unless-tap-untapped-permanent.example: Command Bridge: UnlessOption has no 'tap an untapped permanent you control' option.

effect:unless-target-controller.example: Flusterstorm: "Unless its controller pays {1}" where "its" is the targeted spell (unless's chooser must be a player slot), and storm copies that may choose new targets.

effect:until-next-turn-spell-cost-reduct.example: Ral, Monsoon Mage: back face needs a 'until your next turn' cost reduction, loyalty for spells cast this turn and a free cast from 8 exiled cards; front face's exile-and-return-transformed was not verified either

effect:win-game.example: Thassa's Oracle: "You win the game" isn't an effect.

effect:x-max-player-count.example: Open the Way: X capped at the number of players, and revealing until X land cards.

filter:graveyard-choice-other-than-sourc.example: Ichorid: exile another black creature card from your graveyard — a graveyard choice can't leave out the source card itself (another Ichorid may be chosen).

keyword:addendum.example: Unbreakable Formation: Addendum needs 'this spell was cast during your main phase'; a resolution-time main-phase check would wrongly give a copy the bonus (ruling).

keyword:afflict.example: Cyberman Patrol: no afflict keyword to grant

keyword:aftermath.example: Commit: Commit // Memory is an aftermath split card; aftermath isn't modeled.

keyword:annihilator-x.example: Ulamog, the Defiler: Ward—Sacrifice two permanents, and annihilator X where X is its +1/+1 counters.

keyword:backup.example: Archpriest of Shadows: backup keyword isn't modeled

keyword:bargain.example: Beseech the Mirror: Bargain, and casting the found card free as it resolves.

keyword:behold.example: Champions of the Perfect: behold-and-exile additional cost and returning that exiled card on leave aren't in the vocabulary

keyword:boast.example: Varragoth, Bloodsky Sire: Boast, and a target player's search to the top of their library.

keyword:bolster.example: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit: no bolster (least-toughness choice) effect

keyword:buyback.example: Constant Mists: Buyback — sacrifice a land.

effect:exile-spell-with-delay-counters.example: Ertai's Meddling: exile target spell with X delay counters, removing one each upkeep and putting it back on the stack as an uncast copy at the last

replacement:damage-becomes-fixed-amount-.example: Equal Treatment: this turn, damage a source would deal is 2 instead — would-deal-damage has only multiplier/plus/atLeast, and no spell sets one up for the turn.

replacement:prevent-n-damage-from-each-s.example: Urza's Armor: 'prevent 1 of that damage' from each source — a reduction (plus: -1) is applied after every multiplier, where the affected player chooses the order (rule 616.1).

replacement:temporary-draw-replacement-t.example: Plagiarize: until end of turn, if target player would draw, you draw instead — Notion Thief's draw replacement exists only as a static.

static:cycling-cost-reduction.example: Fluctuator: 'Cycling abilities you activate cost {2} less to activate' — abilityCostModification can't pick out cycling.

static:defending-player-assigns-combat-d.example: Defensive Formation: the defending player, not the attacking player, assigns each attacking creature's combat damage among its blockers.

trigger:chosen-player-draws-named-card.example: Booby Trap: the chosen player reveals each card they draw; when they draw the named card, sacrifice this and deal 10 damage to them

filter:aura-enchant-restriction.example: Rootwater Shaman: "Aura spells with enchant creature" — no CardFilter field reads an Aura's enchant restriction

static:magnet-counter-attack-block-requi.example: Magnetic Web: a creature with a magnet counter attacking forces each other magnet creature to block it if able

effect:destroy-those-that-didnt-attack.example: Maddening Imp: destroy each of the creatures fixed as it resolved that didn't attack this turn (a filter at the end step also catches later arrivals)

decision:choose-keyword-as-cost.example: Phyrexian Splicer: choose flying, ground (sic) — a keyword chosen as part of the cost, both targets' filters depending on it

cost:remove-all-counters.example: Torture Chamber: "remove all pain counters from this artifact" as a cost, and "the number of counters removed this way"
cost:remove-all-counters.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): removeCounter's count is a number or 'x' (any number, chosen by the player), so 'remove all' can't be forced and the number removed can't be guaranteed (Torture Chamber, Essence Bottle). Already there: src/abilities.ts AbilityCost.removeCounter with count 'x' (remove any number, read as x) such as Bottomless Vault

cost:buyback-non-mana.example: Forbid: "Buyback—Discard two cards" — buyback (a kicker keyword) takes a mana cost only; Constant Mists' and Walk the Aeons' sacrifices too. Built 2026-10-26 (B187): kicker.also.

keyword:channel.example: Shigeki, Jukai Visionary: Returning itself to hand as a cost, and channel.

keyword:cleave.example: Wash Away: cleave not modeled (alt cost that removes bracketed text)

keyword:compleated.example: Nissa, Ascended Animist: Compleated (fewer loyalty per Phyrexian pip paid with life) isn't modeled.

keyword:converge.example: Painful Truths: Converge — colors of mana spent.

keyword:corrupted.example: Skrelv's Hive: Toxic Mite tokens and corrupted.

keyword:crewed-it-this-turn.example: Golden Argosy: no tracking of which creatures crewed a Vehicle this turn

keyword:cumulative-upkeep.example: Mystic Remora: Cumulative upkeep {1} needs a cost that scales with the age counters; `may`'s cost is a fixed mana string.
keyword:cumulative-upkeep.description: Cumulative upkeep (rule 702.24), printed or granted one-off (cumulativeUpkeep helper): mana, life and sacrifice costs only; not other costs (cost:cumulative-upkeep-non-mana and the cost:cumulative-upkeep-* keys), a static grant (static:grant-cumulative-upkeep) or a not-paid trigger (trigger:cumulative-upkeep-not-paid).

keyword:dash.example: Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer: Dash isn't modeled, and "exile the top card of that player's library. Until end of turn, you may cast that card" reaches another player's library.

keyword:demonstrate.example: Incarnation Technique: demonstrate (copy, and an opponent copies too) isn't modeled

keyword:descend.example: Brass's Tunnel-Grinder // Tecutlan, the Searing Rift: Discard any number then draw that many plus one, descend, and discover X.

keyword:echo.example: Mogg War Marshal: echo (rule 702.30) — built in batch 193 (the echo() helper)

keyword:embalm.example: Vizier of Many Faces: embalm is unmodeled (AUTHORING §15), and the Clone ability has to carry the embalmed exceptions

keyword:emerge.example: Herigast, Erupting Nullkite: emerge and granting emerge to creature spells

keyword:enchant-modified.example: Lion Umbra: Neither umbra armor nor 'Enchant modified creature' exists.

keyword:endure-x.example: Warden of the Grove: 'It endures X' — endure isn't an effect kind.

keyword:entwine.example: Tooth and Nail: entwine not modeled

keyword:escalate.example: Collective Resistance: Escalate {G}: a cost for each mode beyond the first.

keyword:evoke-alternative-non-mana-cost.example: Grief: evoke is a mana cost only; 'Exile a black card from your hand' isn't supported

keyword:exert.example: Arena of Glory: Exert isn't modeled, nor "if any of that mana is spent on a creature spell, it gains haste".

keyword:expend.example: Wandertale Mentor: no expend N trigger (cumulative mana spent on spells this turn)

keyword:exploit.example: Overcharged Amalgam: exploit and its 'when this exploits' trigger unmodeled; no spell-or-ability counter target

keyword:flanking.example: Sidar Kondo of Jamuraa: Flanking, and opponents' creatures without flying or reach can't block creatures with power 2 or less.

keyword:forage.example: Thornvault Forager: no forage cost, and no 'two mana in any combination of colors'

keyword:gift.example: Long River's Pull: Gift a card.

keyword:harmonize.example: Nature's Rhythm: Harmonize (cast from the graveyard, tapping a creature to reduce the cost).

keyword:hexproof-from-abilities.example: Volatile Stormdrake: Exchange of control, energy upkeep, and hexproof from activated and triggered abilities.

static:hexproof-from-spells-only.example: Fiendslayer Paladin: can't be the target of black or red spells your opponents control (abilities still can)
