keyword:hexproof-from-monocolored.example: Dragonfire Blade: Hexproof from monocolored; equip cost by the target's colors.

keyword:hexproof-from-own-colors.example: Tam, Mindful First-Year: hexproof from each of its colors and 'becomes all colors' aren't modeled

keyword:horsemanship.example: Herald of Hoofbeats: horsemanship keyword not modeled

keyword:impending.example: Overlord of the Hauntwoods: Impending isn't modeled.

keyword:imprint.example: Chrome Mox: Imprint (a linked exile from hand on entry), and mana of any of the exiled card's colours.

keyword:imprint-same-name.example: Extraplanar Lens: Imprint a land and trigger on lands with the same name.

keyword:imprint-shared-type.example: Semblance Anvil: Imprint, and spells sharing a card type with the exiled card.

keyword:improvise.example: Bottle-Cap Blast: No improvise keyword and no 'excess damage dealt this way' amount.

keyword:increment.example: Pensive Professor: no increment trigger (mana spent vs this creature's power/toughness, intervening-if)

keyword:jump-start.example: Quasiduplicate: Jump-start (cast from graveyard for mana cost plus discarding a card) has no vocabulary; flashback takes no discard cost.

keyword:kicker-any-number-of-modes.example: Inscription of Abundance: Life equal to the greatest power among creatures the target player controls; kicked, any number of modes.

keyword:kicker-x.example: Thieving Skydiver: Kicker {X} (X can't be 0), and a gain-control target bound by X.

keyword:level-up.example: Joraga Treespeaker: Level up / leveler layout isn't modeled

keyword:madness.example: Emrakul, the World Anew: protection is colors/types only; madness with {C} cost isn't modeled

keyword:mentor.example: Danny Pink: Mentor keyword (attack trigger targeting an attacking creature with lesser power) isn't modeled.

keyword:modular.description: Modular (rule 702.43): its enters replacement and dies trigger; no marker a filter can read (filter:has-modular).

keyword:monstrosity.example: Giggling Skitterspike: Rechecked: monstrosity (the monstrous designation) isn't modeled. The rest is expressible.

keyword:myriad.example: The Master, Multiplied: myriad, legend-rule exemption for tokens, and a sacrifice/exile prevention for triggered abilities

keyword:nonbasic-landwalk.example: Trailblazer's Boots: Nonbasic landwalk isn't a keyword.

keyword:offering.example: Blast-Furnace Hellkite: artifact offering alt-cast isn't modeled
keyword:offering.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): offering (rule 702.48a) also reduces the total cost by the sacrificed permanent's mana cost and allows casting at instant speed; alternativeCost.sacrifice is an alternative cost of {0} with neither, so Patron of the Kitsune and Blast-Furnace Hellkite's offering are not covered Already there: engine/src/cards/define.ts CardDraft.alternativeCost.sacrifice (e.g. Thunderclap, Fireblast pool cards)

keyword:overload-per-controller-search.example: Winds of Abandon: Overload, and a search for each exiled creature's controller.

keyword:pack-tactics.example: Battle Cry Goblin: pack tactics (total power of attackers this combat) has no condition; attacking-filter aggregate is the drift §15 forbids

keyword:paradigm.example: Improvisation Capstone: Paradigm (repeating free copy each first main phase) and exile-until-total-mana-value are unmodeled.
keyword:paradigm.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): the paradigm itself: exile on first resolve gated on 'first resolve a spell with this name', then a free copy cast from exile each first main phase; the pieces exist separately but nothing ties them together Already there: engine/src/effects.ts cast-now copy-and-cast ('copy ... you may cast the copy', ~line 2723) and on=step-begins trigger (events and trigger vocabulary)

keyword:pawprint-modes.example: Season of Gathering: Pawprint modes, repeatable.
keyword:pawprint-modes.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): castModal modes must be distinct (engine/src/actions.ts distinct mode indices), so repeatable pawprint modes and a pawprint budget per cast are not expressible Already there: engine/src/cards/define.ts CastModalSpec (minModes, maxModes, costPerExtraMode, modes)

keyword:plot.example: Aven Interrupter: Plotting a spell on the stack.

keyword:protection-from-everything.example: Vexilus Praetor: protection is colors/types only (§15)

keyword:protection-from-mana-value.example: Reaver Titan: protection is colors/types only, not 'from mana value 3 or less'

keyword:protection-from-spells-and-cast-.example: Emrakul, the World Anew: protection is colors/types only; madness with {C} cost isn't modeled

keyword:protection-from-subtype.example: Katilda, Dawnhart Prime: protection from Werewolves; protection is colors/types only

keyword:prowl.example: Hunting Velociraptor: Prowl (and a static granting it to Dinosaur spells) isn't modeled.

keyword:read-ahead.example: The Cruelty of Gix: Read ahead isn't modeled

keyword:replicate.example: Hatchery Sliver: replicate and granting replicate to Sliver spells
keyword:replicate.description: Replicate (rule 702.56): a multi kicker with keyword 'replicate' and a mana cost, printed only; not a non-mana cost (cost:replicate-tap-permanent, cost:replicate-energy) or a grant (static:grant-replicate).

keyword:retrace.example: Formless Genesis: A Kindred Sorcery with changeling (the Kindred card type isn't modeled) and retrace (rule 702.81), which isn't built.

keyword:riot.example: Rhythm of the Wild: Riot isn't modeled (AUTHORING §15), and nothing makes the controller's creature spells uncounterable.

keyword:ripple.example: Thrumming Stone: Ripple, granted to the spells you cast.

keyword:shadow.example: Dauthi Voidwalker: Shadow isn't a modeled keyword (also needs a void-counter exile replacement and a play-it-free permission).

keyword:sneak.example: Splinter's Technique: sneak alt cost isn't modeled

condition:more-cards-in-hand-than-each-o.example: Akuta, Born of Ash: 'if you have more cards in hand than each opponent' — no condition compares your hand with every opponent's.

cost:sacrifice-all-lands.example: Tomb of Urami: 'Sacrifice all lands you control' as an activation cost.

condition:target-player-life-total.example: Hidetsugu's Second Rite: 'if target player has exactly 10 life' — life-total reads no target slot.

effect:search-library-to-exile-linked.example: Kaho, Minamo Historian: search for up to three instant cards and exile them, linked to the source for a later 'cast a card with mana value X from among cards exiled with Kaho'.

static:graveyard-cards-gain-chosen-type.example: Ashes of the Fallen: 'Each creature card in your graveyard has the chosen creature type in addition to its other types.'

keyword:epic.example: Enduring Ideal: Epic — can't cast spells for the rest of the game; copy this spell at each of your upkeeps without its epic ability.

keyword:spectacle.example: Light Up the Stage: Spectacle — an alternative cost usable only if an opponent lost life this turn.

keyword:split-second.example: Sudden Spoiling: Split second, and base P/T 0/2 with abilities lost for a player's creatures.

keyword:spree.example: Return the Favor: Spree modes with additional costs, copying an activated/triggered ability, and changing a target.

keyword:sunburst.example: Pentad Prism: sunburst's +1/+1-if-creature branch isn't expressible; a fixed charge-counter converge replacement is wrong if it enters as a creature

keyword:tiered.example: Fire Magic: Tiered written as spree; tiered isn't modelled as its own keyword, and a free cast picks no mode.

keyword:training.example: Torens, Fist of the Angels: training keyword (attacks with a creature with greater power) not modeled

keyword:undaunted.example: Curtains' Call: no cost reduction per opponent

keyword:unearth.example: Cityscape Leveler: Unearth, and Powerstone tokens for the destroyed permanent's controller.

keyword:vanishing.example: Flesh Duplicate: Vanishing isn't modeled, nor a copy exception that adds it only if the copied creature lacks it.

keyword:wither.example: Massacre Girl, Known Killer: Wither isn't modeled.

mechanic:battles.example: Invasion of Ikoria // Zilortha, Apex of Ikoria: A siege battle.

mechanic:begin-game-on-battlefield.example: Leyline of the Void: no opening-hand 'begin the game with it on the battlefield'
mechanic:begin-game-on-battlefield.description: Begin the game on the battlefield (rule 103.6a, beginsOnBattlefield) and reveal from the opening hand (rule 103.6b, mechanic:opening-hand-reveal); not Gemstone Caverns' conditional begin (mechanic:opening-hand-not-starting-player) or a delayed trigger past turn 1 (trigger:opponent-first-spell-of-game).

mechanic:case.example: Case of the Locked Hothouse: No Case (to solve / solved) mechanic, and 'look at the top card of your library any time' is private looking, not revealing.
mechanic:case.description: Cases (rule 719): to solve / solved; not a 'whenever you solve a Case' trigger (trigger:solves-case).

mechanic:class.example: Alchemist's Talent: Class levels aren't modeled.

mechanic:coin-counter-return-trigger.example: Athreos, Shroud-Veiled: devotion-based not-a-creature, and dies-or-exiled return of coin-countered creatures

mechanic:coin-flip-choose-to-stop.example: Fiery Gambit: flip-coin untilLose has no 'or choose to stop flipping', and no 'if you lose a flip, no effect' tiers

mechanic:companion.example: Lurrus of the Dream-Den: companions not modeled (AUTHORING §15)

mechanic:control-attack-block-choices.example: Master Warcraft: choosing which creatures attack and block for other players not modeled

effect:copy-spell-retarget-another-oppon.example: A cast trigger gated on another opponent controlling a permanent the spell could target, then a copy targeting one such permanent the controller chooses (Exterminator Magmarch).

bug:delayed-trigger-carries-lost-trigger.example: createDelayedTrigger carries the creating ability's trigger object at its current zoneChangeCount without checking refs.triggerObjectAfterLeaving, so a card that changed zones again before the creating trigger resolved is still followed (Desert Warfare; Avacyn, Angel of Horror and other dies -> delayed-return cards likely share it).

keyword:two-kicker-costs.example: Two different kicker costs on one card ('Kicker {G} and/or {1}{U}', rule 702.33d), each payable once, with conditions that name which kicker was paid (Wastescape Battlemage, the Zendikar Rising-style 'kicked with its {X} kicker' cards). Built 2026-10-27 (B218): kicker.second, self-kicked's with.

replacement:as-enters-choose-characteris.example: 'As this enters, it becomes your choice of [P/T and keyword sets]' — a choice made as it enters that sets copiable values (layer 1), so copies keep it (Corrupted Shapeshifter, Primal Clay).
replacement:as-enters-choose-characteris.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): the as-enters choice is stored only in GameObject.chosenOnEnter and is not copiable (layer 1), so a copy of Primal Clay would not keep it; statics keyed to it can set base P/T but copies lose it Already there: engine/src/state.ts GameObject.chosenOnEnter; engine/src/cards/define.ts chooseOnEnter (line 2997) and setColors static (line 1354); engine/src/characteristics.ts chosenOnEnter condition (around line 886)

effect:search-to-linked-exile-face-down.example: Search a library and exile the found card face down, linked to the source (rule 607.2), for later abilities to turn face up and put onto the battlefield or into a hand (The Creation of Avacyn's chapters).

cost:exile-from-graveyard-card-types.example: A cost (escape's, here) exiling any number of cards from your graveyard chosen so they have N or more card types among them, rather than a fixed count — Nethergoyf.

stat:granted-once-per-turn-per-grantor.example: 'This ability triggers only once each turn' on a statically granted triggered ability, tracked per grant instance (per granting object, rule 400.7) instead of by the ability's index in the recipient's trigger list — Cursed Wombat's rulings on two Wombats and a Wombat replaced the same turn.

effect:aggregate-all-counters.example: A sum of every counter of every kind on permanents matching a filter — 'X is the number of counters on permanents you control' (Hydra Trainer); AggregateOf counts one named kind. The no-target sibling of effect:aggregate-all-counters-for-target.

effect:grant-ability-to-permanent-spell.example: An effect (a cast trigger's resolution) that grants an ability to a permanent spell on the stack which carries to the permanent it becomes (rule 400.7a) — Thief of Existence's 'If you do, Thief of Existence gains "When this creature leaves the battlefield, target opponent draws a card."'

cost:cost-reduction-count-other.example: A cost reduction counting "each OTHER [permanent] you control" (CostReductionAmount countOf with excludeSelf) — Etherium Pteramander's "{1} less to activate for each other artifact you control".

condition:additional-cost-option-paid.example: A condition reading which additionalCost.options branch was paid — Lethal Throwdown's "sacrifice a creature or sacrifice a modified creature … If the modified creature was sacrificed, draw a card".

effect:owner-chooses-library-position.example: A permanent's owner chooses where in their library it goes — Deem Inferior's "second from the top or on the bottom".

mechanic:exalted-counters.example: Exalted counters (rule 122.1b): each gives the permanent an instance of exalted — needs exalted as a keyword whose instances the attacks-alone pump counts (Emissary of Soulfire).

replacement:enters-with-keyword.example: An enters-battlefield replacement that has the permanent enter with a keyword (haste) as an effect timestamped as it enters, optionally gated on how it was cast (kicked) — Voidpouncer's "if this creature was kicked, it enters with ... and with haste".

replacement:counter-replacement-you-put.example: A would-add-counter replacement that applies only when its controller is the player putting the counters ('If you would put one or more counters on a permanent you control' — Doc Samson; 122.6a for entering counters): counterTotal would need the putting player (addCounter's `by`).

static:your-life-total-cant-change.example: "Your life total can't change" as a static on a permanent (Platinum Emperion), not the temporary player-effect Teferi's Protection uses.

static:player-protection-from-opponents.example: "You have protection from each of your opponents" (Absolute Virtue, rule 702.16k): a static player protection from anything opponents control.

replacement:player-counter-addend.example: "If you would get one or more counters, you get that many plus one" (Winding Constrictor): the counter-addend replacement over a player's counters.

effect:grant-instant-speed-loyalty-until.example: "Until end of turn, you may activate loyalty abilities of [filter] planeswalkers you control … any time you could cast an instant" (Jace's Machinations): instant-speed loyalty granted for a duration.

effect:exile-spell-as-it-resolves-linked.example: An optional "you may exile that spell instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard as it resolves", the card exiled linked to the source (rule 607.2a) so a later "cards exiled with this" ability reaches it (Forger's Foundry); exile-spell-as-it-resolves is mandatory and unlinked.

trigger:activates-ability-targeting.example: An activates-ability trigger narrowed to abilities with a target of a given kind (Ertha Jo: "whenever you activate an ability that targets a creature or player").

trigger:damage-equal-to-toughness.example: A deals-damage trigger clause matching only damage to a creature equal to that creature's toughness (ignoring damage already marked) — Taii Wakeen.

replacement:damage-plus-x-this-turn.example: An effect (from an activated ability) creating a this-turn would-deal-damage +X replacement for sources you control, X fixed at resolution — Taii Wakeen's {X},{T} ability.

effect:count-target-players-not-done-thi.example: An amount counting the players in an any-number target slot for whom a this-way result didn't happen ("for each of those opponents who didn't discard a card with mana value 4 or greater, draw a card" — Hollow Marauder), after a simultaneous for-each-target discard.

trigger:becomes-attached.example: A 'whenever an Aura [you control] becomes attached to [filter]' trigger carrying the Aura and the permanent, so an intervening comparison (mana value of the permanent <= the Aura's) and the effect can read both (Eriette, the Beguiler).
trigger:becomes-attached.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): No on=becomes-attached trigger; the permanent-attached event is emitted but only the predicate escape hatch can match it, and that gets no source, controller or host, so the Aura's controller, the host filter, the MV comparison and the trigger objects cannot be expressed. Already there: engine/src/events.ts permanent-attached event; engine/src/game.ts permanent-attached emits (~27160, ~28181, ~37812); engine/src/abilities.ts TriggerSpec on=predicate (~1914) matched in game.ts triggerMatches case predicate (~20178); eventTriggerObject (~20872) has no permanent-attached case

effect:control-while-attached.example: gain-control 'for as long as that Aura is attached to it': the control effect ends when a named Aura leaves or becomes unattached from the permanent, and does nothing if it already has as the ability resolves (Eriette, the Beguiler's ruling).

decision:choose-face-up-exiled-card.example: Choose (without targeting) a face-up card in exile that a given player owns as an effect resolves, and move it to another zone — Binding Negotiation's 'you may put a face-up exiled card they own into their graveyard'.

condition:controlled-as-cast.example: 'If you controlled a [filter] as you cast this spell' — a board condition snapshotted when the spell finished being cast and read on resolution, not asked again then (Steer Clear).

effect:temporary-counter-addend.example: A player-effect 'until end of turn, if you would put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature you control, put that many plus one instead', cumulative per resolution and reaching enters-with-counters (Prairie Dog).

bug:cda-turn-stat.example: A CDA count (setBasePtFromCount's CountSpec) that reads a per-player turn stat, e.g. cards drawn this turn — Duelist of the Mind's '*/3, power equal to the number of cards you've drawn this turn'.

effect:look-and-choose-unlinked-exile.example: A look-and-choose exile that isn't a linked ability: destination 'exile' always records exiledWith on the source's stint (rule 607.2a), so a later copied 'the exiled card' ability on the same permanent finds it (Lazav, Familiar Stranger's 'you may exile a card from a graveyard', then becoming a copy of it).

effect:token-copy-each-other.example: create-token-copy's { each } filter leaving out the effect's source — 'for each other nonland permanent you control, create a token that's a copy of that permanent' (Oko, the Ringleader's −5).

cost:plot-cost-reduction.example: A static that changes the cost of the plot special action (rule 702.170a) — Doc Aurlock's "Plotting cards from your hand costs {2} less" (generic only).

static:pt-per-cards-in-hand.example: grantPtPerCount counting the cards in a player's hand — Stingerback Terror's "gets -1/-1 for each card in your hand" (layer 7c, not a base P/T characteristic-defining ability).
static:pt-per-cards-in-hand.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): grantPtPerCount (layer 7c) has no hand count, so a non-characteristic-defining +X/+X per card in hand (Stingerback Terror, Behold the Unspeakable, Alrund) is missing; only the characteristic-defining base P/T form exists Already there: engine/src/cards/pool/psychosis-crawler.ts setBasePtFromCount { countOf: "cards-in-your-hand" } (CountSpec in engine/src/cards/define.ts line 398)

effect:reflexive-refers-to-parent-target.example: A reflexive ('When you do, …') trigger's effect acting on the creating ability's own target without targeting it again — Behemoth of Vault 0's 'you may pay {E} equal to target nonland permanent's mana value. When you do, destroy that permanent.'

effect:reflexive-per-counters-placed.example: A reflexive trigger that fires once per N counters actually placed by the step before it (Craig Boone's 'put two quest counters … When you do' — twice under Doubling Season, per its ruling).

effect:restrict-rule-for-player.example: A turn-wide restrict rule (rule 611.2c, binding later arrivals) over creatures one chosen player controls — 'creatures that player controls without flying can't block this turn' (The Motherlode, Excavator), the defending player or a target's controller.

effect:target-creature-blocking-attached.example: A target spec / filter clause for a creature blocking the Equipment's (or Aura's) host — Plasma Caster's 'target creature that's blocking equipped creature'.

static:doesnt-untap-attached.example: 'Equipped creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step' — doesntUntap on an attached (or filtered) scope rather than the static's own permanent (T-45 Power Armor).

trigger:discards-first-time-each-turn.example: A firstTimeEachTurn on the discards trigger, read off the turn's discards before the source arrived too — 'whenever you discard one or more nonland cards for the first time each turn' (Veronica, Dissident Scribe).

zone:play-exiled-this-way-after-choice.example: Granting a play permission (lands included) this turn to the card an earlier step of the same resolution exiled, after a choice in between — Synth Eradicator's 'exile the top card … You may get {E}{E}. If you don't, you may play that card this turn.'

effect:base-power-amount.example: An EffectAmount reading an object's base power (after layer 7b, last-known if gone) — Curie, Emergent Intelligence's 'draw cards equal to its base power'.

effect:target-per-graveyard-with-match.example: 'For each graveyard with an [X] card in it, exile target [X] card from that graveyard' — one mandatory target slot per graveyard that has a match, none for one that doesn't (Mysterious Stranger).

static:activated-abilities-of-exiled-wit.example: Rex, Cyber-Hound: 'has all activated abilities of all cards in exile with brain counters on them' — like grantsActivatedOfLinkedExile, but over every exiled card carrying a counter kind, not just cards linked to this permanent.

cost:cost-reduction-creatures-attacking-.example: Sentry Bot: 'costs {1} less to cast for each creature attacking you' — a CostReductionAmount counting creatures attacking the caster (the { attackingPlayer } EffectAmount's count).

static:graveyard-cast-filter-amount.example: Arcade Gannon: a castFromGraveyard permission whose filter compares against an amount ('mana value less than or equal to the number of quest counters on Arcade Gannon') — the permission's filter is matched without FilterContext.amount, so it fails closed.

effect:random-permanent.example: The Nipton Lottery: 'choose a creature at random' on the battlefield, untargeted, then act on it (and on all others) — choose-random-card reads only a graveyard.

effect:reveal-cards-from-hand.example: Vault 21: House Gambit: 'reveal up to five nonland cards from your hand' as an effect, then a count over the revealed set (cards sharing a mana value with another revealed card).

effect:attach-to-chosen-creature.example: Vault 101: Birthday Party: 'you may attach it to a creature you control' — attach an Equipment just put onto the battlefield to a creature chosen as the effect resolves, without targeting (AUTHORING §6 attach: 'Not yet … to a creature chosen without targeting').

keyword:scavenge.example: Scavenge (rule 702.97): exile the card from your graveyard and pay its scavenge cost to put +1/+1 counters equal to its power on target creature, sorcery speed — printed, and granted to graveyard cards with the cost equal to their mana cost (Young Deathclaws).

cost:cost-reduction-all-counters.example: Lumbering Megasloth: 'costs {1} less to cast for each counter among players and permanents' — a CostReductionAmount summing every counter of every kind on every permanent and player.

effect:aura-token-copies-attached.example: Three Dog, Galaxy News DJ: an optional cost of sacrificing an Aura attached to the source, and a reflexive 'for each other attacking creature you control, create a token copy of that Aura attached to that creature' (untargeted, skipped where it couldn't legally attach).

mechanic:secret-choice.example: Players choose secretly and reveal simultaneously: a secret vote (for objects or named options) and 'each secretly choose a number' (Vault 11: Voter's Dilemma, Expert-Level Safe).

keyword:enlist.example: Enlist (rule 702.154): as it attacks, optionally tap a nonattacking, non-sick creature you control to add its power until end of turn; plus an 'if it enlisted a creature this combat' condition (Aradesh, the Founder).

keyword:fortify.example: Fortification artifacts and Fortify [cost] (rule 702.67): attach to a land you control at sorcery speed, with a 'fortified land' scope and triggers (C.A.M.P.).

static:pt-per-counters-among-permanents.example: grantPtPerCount by the number of counters of one kind among permanents a player controls ('+1/+1 for each quest counter among permanents you control' — Moira Brown's Wasteland Survival Guide).

effect:grant-escape-until-end-of-turn.example: A one-shot 'target card in your graveyard gains escape until end of turn', escape cost its mana cost plus exiling N other graveyard cards (Desdemona, Freedom's Edge).

effect:restrict-all-target-player.example: A combat restriction over every creature a target player controls ('creatures target player controls can't block this turn' — Headliner Scarlett): restrict's filter can't point at a target player.

condition:attacking-player-left-an-oppon.example: Intervening-if on a 'player attacks you' trigger: the attacking player has another opponent who isn't being attacked (Suppressor Skyguard).

trigger:mentors.example: Aegis of the Legion: 'Whenever equipped creature mentors a creature' — a trigger on a mentor ability of the attached (or own) creature resolving and putting its counter, with the mentored creature as the trigger object.

effect:sacrifice-all-but-up-to-n.example: Covetous Elegy: 'each player chooses up to N creatures they control, then sacrifices the rest' with fewer allowed (min 0), each player asked in APNAP order knowing earlier choices, every unchosen permanent sacrificed at once — sacrifice-all-but keeps exactly N and sacrifices player by player.

keyword:collect-evidence.example: Collect evidence N (rule 701.59): exile any number of cards from your graveyard with total mana value N or more, possible only if the graveyard can reach N — as an additional cost, an optional 'you may collect evidence N' in an effect, and the reflexive 'when you do' after it (Memory Vampire).

static:unblockable-defending-player-cond.example: Can't be blocked as long as the defending player meets a player condition (has a rad counter — Nightkin Ambusher), checked as blocks are declared; landwalk is the only defender-condition evasion today.
static:unblockable-defending-player-cond.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): cant-be-blocked restriction exists but static conditions are read against the static's controller, not the defending player; Ayesha and Scrapdiver Serpent need a defender-scoped condition, and Nightkin Ambusher a rad-counter player condition Already there: engine/src/cards/define.ts CombatRestriction cant-be-blocked and StaticAbility.restrictions; condition field on StaticAbility

effect:delayed-cast-trigger-through-play.example: A delayed trigger installed on a named player (the defending player) that fires each time they cast a spell, lasting until the end of that player's next turn (Nuka-Nuke Launcher).

effect:return-as-aura-with-granted-abili.example: Return a card to the battlefield as an Aura enchantment with a given enchant restriction (Forest you control), choosing what it enchants as it enters, granting the enchanted permanent an ability and losing all its other abilities (Harold and Bob, First Numens).

keyword:squad-nonmana-cost.example: A squad cost that isn't only mana — exiling cards from your graveyard (Ruthless Radrat) or {1} plus a discard (Thrill-Kill Disciple) — paid any number of times as the spell is cast.

replacement:life-loss-from-radiation.example: Life lost from the rad-counter trigger (rule 728.1a) marked as 'from radiation' so a replacement can change it — Strong, the Brutish Thespian's 'You gain life rather than lose life from radiation'.

stat:milled-this-turn-mill-only.example: A per-card 'milled this turn' marker set only by a mill (rule 701.17), not by surveil or other library-to-graveyard moves — Tato Farmer and The Master, Transcendent's 'card in a graveyard that was milled this turn' (their rulings exclude cards put there without the word mill).

replacement:enter-tapped-optional-rider.example: 'You may have this permanent enter tapped. If you do, [effect]' — an optional enter-tapped choice asked as it enters (rule 614.12), with an effect when taken — Mariposa Military Base's 'If you do, you get two rad counters'.

effect:goad-while-counter.example: A one-shot effect that makes a creature goaded, unable to attack you or permanents you control, and unable to block creatures you control for as long as it has a counter of a kind (Immortal Obligation's duty counter).

static:pt-per-turn-stat.example: A static P/T bonus counting a turn stat — 'creatures you control get +X/+X, where X is the number of cards you've drawn this turn' (Knowledge Is Power): grantPtPerCount with a turnStat.

effect:create-token-enters-with-counters.example: A created token that enters with N counters (a replacement as it enters, rule 614.1c), not thenCounters' put-after: 'The token enters with X +1/+1 counters on it' (Printlifter Ooze).

static:trigger-doubler-turned-face-up.example: A doubleTriggers cause for a face-down permanent turning face up (Panoptic Projektor).

effect:choose-new-targets-any-number.example: 'You may choose new targets for any number of other spells and/or abilities' (Boltbender): an untargeted change-targets over a chosen set of stack objects.

effect:exile-self-with-time-counters.example: A resolving spell exiles itself with N time counters, becoming suspended again if it has suspend (Charnel Serenade).
effect:exile-self-with-time-counters.existsEvidence: give-suspend with target "source" (Cyclical Evolution, Inspiring Refrain, B241)

zone:play-from-graveyard-surveilled-this.example: Play lands and cast spells from among graveyard cards you put there by surveilling this turn, paying life equal to mana value instead of the mana cost (Eye of Duskmantle).

keyword:unleash.example: Unleash (rule 702.98): may enter with a +1/+1 counter; can't block while it has one — printed, and granted to entering creatures by a static (Tesak, Judith's Hellhound).

effect:copy-spell-for-each-chosen-paid.example: Copy a spell once for each of any number of chosen objects it could target, paying a cost per copy, each copy targeting its object (Feather, Radiant Arbiter).

stat:permanents-to-graveyard-from-battle.example: A turn count of permanents put into graveyards from the battlefield (any controller, tokens included, filterable by type) — gravestorm, Anzrag's Rampage's artifacts.
stat:permanents-to-graveyard-from-battle.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): no count of permanents put into a graveyard from the battlefield: turn-history 'left' counts every exit including exile and bounce, and 'died' is creatures under your control only Already there: engine/src/effects.ts turnHistory amount (around line 664) with TurnHistoryKind 'left' (engine/src/state.ts:3275, TurnHistory.left)

effect:ungoad.example: 'Each creature you control is no longer goaded' (Serene Sleuth): end every goad on matching creatures.

effect:exile-top-face-down-linked.example: Exile the top card of a library face down where nobody may look at it ('You can't look at it'), linked to the source (rule 607.2a) with no play permission — Connecting the Dots.
effect:exile-top-face-down-linked.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): no face-down exile that nobody may look at: look-and-choose destination exile-face-down (linked via exiledWith) lets the chooser look, and impulse-exile faceDown grants the controller a play permission; Wall of Mourning's unlooked exile is not covered Already there: engine/src/effects.ts look-and-choose destination 'exile-face-down' and impulse-exile faceDown

condition:put-into-graveyard-this-turn-f.example: A CardFilter clause for a card in a graveyard that was put there from anywhere this turn (not only from a library) — Reenact the Crime.

effect:look-and-choose-cloak.example: A look-and-choose destination that cloaks the chosen cards (face-down 2/2s with ward {2}, rule 701.58) rather than manifesting them — Hide in Plain Sight.

effect:amount-color-pairs.example: An amount counting the different color pairs among permanents matching a filter that are exactly two colors — Niv-Mizzet, Guildpact.

keyword:hexproof-from-multicolored.example: Hexproof from multicolored (rule 702.11d): can't be the target of multicolored spells or abilities from multicolored sources opponents control — Niv-Mizzet, Guildpact.

condition:filter-dealt-damage-this-turn.example: A CardFilter clause for a permanent that dealt damage this turn to anything (players, planeswalkers, creatures) — Treacherous Greed's sacrifice cost.

effect:choose-per-player-untargeted.example: For each player, the controller chooses up to one permanent that player controls (untargeted), the chosen ones are acted on together, then each affected permanent's controller may follow up — Krenko's Buzzcrusher.

bug:cda-count-multiplier.example: A setBasePtFromCount multiplier for a CDA of 'twice the number of …' — Melek, Reforged Researcher.

condition:player-controls-most.example: A player scope or that-player condition for 'each player who controls the most [filter]' (ties included) — No Witnesses.
condition:player-controls-most.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): No per-player 'controls the most' scope with ties (Tectonic Hellion), and no 'controls more than each other player' (Advice from the Fae): opponent-controls-more is strict but means some one opponent, so its negation lets ties through. Already there: src/cards/define.ts StaticCondition kind opponent-controls-more (some one opponent controls strictly more than you; filter, activePlayerOnly)

cost:disguise-x-cost.example: A morph/disguise cost with {X} (Aurelia's Vindicator's Disguise {X}{3}{W}): the turn-face-up special action announces X, and its turned-face-up trigger reads it ("up to X targets").

effect:cast-now-from-each-opponent-grave.example: "You may cast a spell from each opponent's graveyard without paying its mana cost" (Jetsam): an untargeted cast-now offered once per opponent from that player's graveyard, chosen as the effect resolves (after an earlier step such as a mill).

static:cant-become-suspected.example: A static that stops affected creatures from becoming suspected (Airtight Alibi's "enchanted creature ... can't become suspected"), checked by Game.suspect.

effect:put-onto-battlefield-attached.example: Put an Aura/Equipment card onto the battlefield attached to a named permanent (Magnetic Snuffler's "return target Equipment card from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to this creature"), entering unattached when it can't legally attach.

cost:disguise-cost-reduction.example: A disguise (or morph) cost reduced by a live count as it's paid — Fugitive Codebreaker's "Disguise {5}{R}. This cost is reduced by {1} for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard".

static:cant-turn-face-up.example: A static that stops a set of permanents being turned face up, by any cost — Karlov Watchdog's "Permanents your opponents control can't be turned face up during your turn".

effect:look-and-choose-revealed-card-des.example: One revealed card whose destination depends on it and the chooser — Break Out's "you may reveal a creature card … If that card has mana value 2 or less, you may put it onto the battlefield … If you didn't, put it into your hand" (a second pick that keeps the first's reveal:"chosen").

replacement:as-turned-face-up-dynamic-co.example: `asTurnedFaceUp` counters as an amount read as it's turned face up — Crowd-Control Warden's "put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of other creatures you control".

decision:secret-choice.example: A choice made secretly on resolution (hidden from other players, remembered per permanent) and a "reveal the [choice]" activation cost only the chooser can pay — A Killer Among Us.

stat:sacrificed-this-turn.example: Turn tally of the permanents a player sacrificed, by type — Suspicious Detonation's "if you've sacrificed an artifact this turn" as a selfCostReduction condition.

trigger:dealt-damage-amount-threshold.example: A `dealt-damage` trigger gated on the amount of one damage event — Innocent Bystander's "Whenever this creature is dealt 3 or more damage" (all at once, not cumulative).

effect:must-block-this-turn.example: A 'blocks this turn if able' requirement on a target creature (rule 509.1c) — Hustle's 'attacks or blocks this turn if able'; the `restrict` effect has must-attack but no must-block.
effect:must-block-this-turn.description: Not: a filter form for each creature (effect:block-if-able-each-creature), keeping it when the attacker slot is illegal (effect:block-if-able-illegal-attacker-slot).

effect:look-at-face-down-permanents.example: 'Until end of turn, you may look at face-down creatures you don't control any time' (Lumbering Laundry): a per-player view permission over other players' face-down permanents (not spells), lasting until end of turn.

keyword:collect-evidence-x.example: Collect evidence X with a variable X: chosen as an effect resolves and read by what follows ('you may collect evidence X. When you do, ... X damage' — Incinerator of the Guilty), or computed as a mandatory additional cost from the spell's targets' total mana value (Urgent Necropsy).

decision:ward-collect-evidence.example: 'Ward—Collect evidence N' (Axebane Ferox): the targeting player may exile cards from their graveyard with total mana value N or more, payable only if their graveyard holds that much; otherwise the spell or ability is countered.

effect:extract-same-name.example: Exile a chosen card from an opponent's graveyard, then search its owner's graveyard, hand and library for any number of cards with that name and exile them; that player shuffles (Deadly Cover-Up then has them draw a card for each card exiled from their hand).
effect:extract-same-name.description: Still missing (2026-10-27 check): no hand in search zones, so Deadly Cover-Up and Dispossess cannot search graveyard, hand and library; Dispossess also needs a chosen artifact name, which no effect chooses Already there: src/filter.ts sameNameAsTarget and sameNameAsTriggerObject; src/effects.ts SearchZones and kind 'search-library' (zones)

cost:alt-cost-collect-evidence-for-spell.example: 'You may collect evidence N rather than pay the mana cost for spells you cast' (Conspiracy Unraveler): a static alternative cost for every spell that is a collect-evidence payment, not mana; it isn't the spell's own 'if evidence was collected' and can't use the card being cast from the graveyard.

effect:may-exile-self-and-collect-eviden.example: 'You may exile it and collect evidence N. If you do, ...' effect:discard-duplicate-names.example: Hint of Insanity: 'discards all nonland cards with the same name as another card in their hand'.

effect:attach-aura-to-land-chosen-by-pla.example: Steam Vines: 'that land's controller attaches Steam Vines to a land of their choice' — chosen, not targeted, by another player.

effect:reveal-top-opponent-library-you-c.example: Balshan Beguiler: 'that player reveals the top two cards of their library. Choose one of them and put it into their graveyard.'

cost:choose-number-additional.example: Liquid Fire: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, choose a number between 0 and 5' — a castModal of six modes makes it a modal spell.

effect:delayed-trigger-about-trigger-rec.example: Serpentine Basilisk: 'whenever it deals combat damage to a creature, destroy that creature at end of combat' — a delayed trigger made by a deals-damage trigger keeps only the trigger object, so "trigger-recipient" resolves to nothing when it fires.

effect:gain-control-to-player-with-most-.example: Thoughtbound Primoc: 'at the beginning of your upkeep, if a player controls more Wizards than each other player, that player gains control of it'.

effect:prevent-next-damage-to-you-from-f.example: Circle of Solace: 'the next time a creature of the chosen type would deal damage to you this turn, prevent that damage' — next-time prevention covers one chosen source only.

filter:shares-creature-type-with-sacrifi.example: Endemic Plague: 'destroy all creatures that share a creature type with the sacrificed creature' — only card types are compared with a sacrificed creature.

static:assign-combat-damage-divided-amon.example: Butcher Orgg: 'you may assign its combat damage divided as you choose among defending player and/or any number of creatures they control', blocked or not.

static:cant-be-blocked-unless-defender-c.example: Graxiplon: 'can't be blocked unless defending player controls three or more creatures that share a creature type'.

replacement:prevent-damage-at-most-n.example: Callous Giant: 'If a source would deal 3 or less damage to this creature, prevent that damage' — no amount threshold on the damage replacement.

static:cant-attack-unless-matching-also-.example: Scarred Puma: "can't attack unless a black or green creature also attacks"

effect:owner-of-source-player-ref.description: The source's owner as the player an effect acts for ('Gandalf's owner shuffles him into their library and draws three cards'): draw's who names only scopes, never the source's owner.

effect:tap-all-trigger-player-scope.description: tap-all over the permanents of the player a trigger names — the damaged player, the defending player, the entering land's controller ('tap all lands that player controls'): tap-all narrows only to a target slot's player.

effect:scope-opponents-who-lost-life-thi.description: A PlayerScope for 'each opponent who lost life this turn' (each one choosing in turn order, the sacrifices simultaneous).

effect:modify-pt-all-defending-player.description: modify-pt-all over the creatures the defending player of an attack trigger controls ('creatures defending player controls get -1/-1'): its filter's controlledBy has no defending player.

effect:manifest-dread-owner-of-linked-ex.description: 'The exiled card's owner manifests dread': manifest-dread's who takes only you or a target's controller, and nothing names the owner of the card exiled with the source.

effect:discard-hand-target-players.description: discard-hand for the players in an any-number target slot ('any number of target opponents each discard their hands, then draw seven cards'): discard-hand takes only a scope.

effect:delayed-return-source-from-gravey.description: A delayed 'return this card to the battlefield at the beginning of the next end step' that returns the card only from the graveyard it went to, as the same object (rule 400.7): no pool card shows a delayed put-onto-battlefield 'source' gated that way.

effect:put-from-hand-or-graveyard.description: 'Put a creature card … onto the battlefield from your hand or graveyard': one choice across both zones.

effect:put-onto-battlefield-grant-keywor.description: A card put onto the battlefield 'has flying and is an Angel in addition to its other types' from the moment it enters (rule 611.2e?): put-onto-battlefield adds subtypes but grants no keywords.

effect:random-card-from-revealed.description: 'Put a random creature card from among them onto the battlefield' — a random pick among cards an effect revealed from a library.

effect:random-subset-of-looked-cards.description: 'Look at the top eight cards of your library. Exile four of them at random, then put the rest on top in any order.'

effect:discard-random-filtered.description: 'Reveals their hand and discards a creature card at random': a random discard among the cards matching a filter (discard's random takes no filter).

effect:random-player-per-permanent.description: 'For each nonland permanent, choose a player at random. Then each player gains control of each permanent for which they were chosen.'

effect:reflexive-up-to-that-many-targets.description: 'You may sacrifice one or more Treasures. When you do, up to that many target creatures …': a variable sacrifice whose count sets the reflexive trigger's number of targets.

effect:sacrifice-one-of-trigger-batch.description: 'You may sacrifice one of them' — one of the creatures a batched trigger (one or more creatures dealing combat damage) fired on, then reading the sacrificed creature.

effect:reveal-until-found-destination-by.description: Reveal until a creature card, then onto the battlefield if its mana value is at most the number of lands you control, otherwise into your hand: reveal-until's put is one fixed destination.

effect:discard-unless-sacrifice-per-card.description: 'For each card drawn this way, discard a card unless you sacrifice a permanent': one simultaneous choice of permanents to sacrifice, the rest of the count discarded.

effect:choose-color-become-color.description: 'Choose a color. This artifact becomes the chosen color' as an ability resolves: become-color takes fixed colours, chooseOnEnter is as-enters.

effect:shuffle-graveyard-cards-filtered.description: 'Shuffle all creature cards of [the chosen type] from your graveyard into your library': shuffle-graveyard-into-library moves the whole graveyard, with no filter.

target:other-than-source-unless-creature.description: 'Target creatures and/or other planeswalkers' — the source excluded only as a planeswalker, still targetable while it's a creature (the ruling): kind 'other' drops the source whole.

target:ability-source-filter.description: An ability target narrowed by its source beyond card types: 'from a colorless source' (Abstruse Archaic), 'from another legendary source that's not a commander' (The Peregrine Dynamo).

target:any-number-max-total-mana-value.description: 'Any number of target … with total mana value X or less': any-number has maxTotalPower only.

target:stack-spell-filter.description: The stack target ('spell, activated ability, or triggered ability') with its spells narrowed by a filter — 'legendary spell' (Tale's End), 'noncreature spell' (Louisoix's Sacrifice): stack's spells is any, instant-or-sorcery or none.

target:loyalty-ability.description: 'Counter target loyalty ability of a planeswalker': the ability target has abilityKind activated or triggered, no loyalty.

effect:opponents-cant-gain-life-this-tur.description: 'Your opponents can't gain life this turn' as a resolving effect: player-effect covers only its controller.

effect:creature-spells-uncounterable-thi.description: 'Creature spells you cast this turn can't be countered' as a loyalty ability's effect.

amount:greatest-power-this-way.description: The greatest power among creature cards an effect put into a graveyard or exiled this way (Discerning Taste, Szat's Will): thisWay amounts count or sum, never take the greatest.

condition:this-way-counts-commander-redi.description: Counting the nontoken permanents you controlled returned to hand this way, a commander its owner put in the command zone instead included (Flood of Tears' ruling).

condition:per-player-this-way.description: A condition per player on what that player did this way: 'each opponent who didn't discard a nonland card this way loses 3 life'.

condition:damage-dealt-this-way-to-trigg.description: damage-dealt-this-way about the trigger object rather than a target slot, with a filter on it ('if a Dinosaur is dealt damage this way'): its to is a slot index only.

effect:animated-this-way.description: A this-way record of the permanents an animate or animate-all made creatures ('put four +1/+1 counters on each artifact that became a creature this way', overloaded).

effect:token-copy-of-sacrificed.description: create-token-copy of the creature sacrificed as the cost: its of has no 'sacrificed'.

effect:this-turn-cast-trigger-copy-chose.description: A chapter's 'whenever you cast a noncreature spell this turn, create a token that's a copy of a non-Saga token you control' — a turn-long delayed trigger copying an untargeted choice.

effect:token-copy-one-of-batch.description: 'Create a token that's a copy of one of them' — one chosen creature of a batched entry, not each of them or the first.

effect:token-copy-if-noncreature-animate.description: A token copy that, if it isn't a creature, becomes a 2/2 Robot Villain creature in addition to its other types — an exception conditional on the copy's types.

effect:token-copy-of-spell-target.description: create-token-copy of the permanent the cast spell (the trigger object) targets.

effect:for-each-permanent-unless-any-pla.description: 'For each land, destroy that land unless any player pays 1 life' — an unless per permanent, asked of every player.

effect:unless-any-opponent-pays.description: 'Unless an opponent pays {2}': the unless chooser any-player asks you too; nothing asks the opponents alone.

amount:chosen-targets-remaining.example: Disorienting Choice: How many of the spell's chosen targets are still on the battlefield (or weren't exiled) as it finishes resolving.
amount:chosen-targets-remaining.description: How many of the spell's chosen targets are still on the battlefield (or weren't exiled) as it finishes resolving.

amount:opponents-attacked-this-turn.example: Rose, Cutthroat Raider: The number of opponents you attacked at any point this turn; opponentsAttacked reads only this combat's attackers.
amount:opponents-attacked-this-turn.description: The number of opponents you attacked at any point this turn; opponentsAttacked reads only this combat's attackers.

amount:opponents-with-more-cards-in-hand.example: Wojek Investigator: The number of opponents with more cards in hand than you (investigate once for each).
amount:opponents-with-more-cards-in-hand.description: The number of opponents with more cards in hand than you (investigate once for each).

effect:cast-copy-from-opponents-hand.example: Reversal of Fortune: Copy a card in an opponent's revealed hand and cast the copy; cast-now has no opponent's-hand source.
effect:cast-copy-from-opponents-hand.description: Copy a card in an opponent's revealed hand and cast the copy; cast-now has no opponent's-hand source.

effect:change-target-new-target-restrict.example: Meddle: Change the target of a spell or ability to a new one that must also match a filter (a creature, a player, this creature), narrower than what the spell could target.
effect:change-target-new-target-restrict.description: Change the target of a spell or ability to a new one that must also match a filter (a creature, a player, this creature), narrower than what the spell could target.

target:stack-object-targets-filter.example: Silver Wyvern: A target spec for 'target spell or ability that targets only [this creature]': SpellTargetsFilter matches spells only, and single means every target is the same object.
target:stack-object-targets-filter.description: A target spec for 'target spell or ability that targets only [this creature]': SpellTargetsFilter matches spells only, and single means every target is the same object.

replacement:opponent-chooses-creature-ty.description: 'As this enters, an opponent chooses a creature type': chooseCreatureTypeOnEnter is the controller's choice.

effect:sacrifice-permanent-of-opponents-.description: You sacrifice a permanent an opponent picks; sacrifice and its unless forms are the sacrificer's own choice.

effect:each-opponent-picks-from-shared-r.description: Each opponent in turn picks a different card from one shared reveal; look-and-choose gives one chooser one pick.

effect:look-and-choose-leftover-exile-wi.description: look-and-choose's leftover exiled with a counter (Karn's silver counter).

effect:return-from-exile-with-counter.description: Put a card you own with a given counter from exile into your hand.

filter:chosen-permanents-not-controlled-.description: Each player chooses a creature the caster doesn't control, then all chosen are destroyed together.

effect:each-player-chooses-color-for-own.description: Each player chooses a color in turn order, then each permanent is exiled unless colorless or only its controller's chosen color.

effect:exchange-control-permanent-and-sp.description: Exchange control of this permanent and a spell on the stack; the spell's new controller may choose new targets.

static:cant-pay-life-or-sacrifice-nonlan.description: Players can't pay life or sacrifice nonland permanents to cast spells or activate abilities.

effect:delayed-whenever-batched-damage.description: A delayed 'whenever' on deals-damage-batch fires once per source, not once per damaged player (Jace, Cunning Castaway's +1 likely over-triggers too).

effect:delayed-whenever-per-card-graveya.description: A delayed 'whenever a card is put into a graveyard' firing per card, with that card's owner as 'that player'.

effect:delayed-trigger-next-attack.description: 'When you next attack this turn': a one-shot delayed trigger on your next attack.

effect:delayed-trigger-chosen-players-ne.description: A delayed trigger at a chosen opponent's next end step, with a condition on that turn ('they didn't attack you').

effect:delayed-trigger-reads-creator-x.description: A delayed trigger reading the X its creating spell was cast with.

effect:delayed-trigger-remembers-that-pl.description: A delayed trigger acting for a remembered player (the caster who paid), not its controller.
