effect:restrict-dealt-damage-this-way.description: Restrict ('attacks this turn if able') each creature dealt damage this way.

amount:cards-in-target-player-hand.description: The number of cards in a target player's hand as an amount (add-mana and others); `{cardsInHand}` takes only a scope.

condition:source-attacked-this-combat.description: 'If [this] attacked this combat': true for a creature declared as an attacker this combat even after it's removed from combat, false across a later extra combat.

cost:ability-cost-reduction-first-each-t.description: A static reducing only the first activated ability of a matching permanent you activate each turn (mana abilities included); `abilityCostModification` has no first-each-turn form.

effect:block-if-able-each-creature.description: 'Each creature [filter] blocks this turn if able' as a rule for the turn, binding creatures that enter later; `block-if-able` takes only a target.

effect:block-if-able-illegal-attacker-sl.description: A block requirement that stays when the creature to be blocked is a target found illegal on resolution but still on the battlefield (Feral Contest's ruling); `block-if-able` drops it, the illegal slot being blanked.

effect:change-targets-same-new-target.description: Change the target of a spell that targets only this creature, every slot to the same new target (the ruling); `change-targets` retargets each slot separately.

effect:flicker-optional-immediate-or-del.description: Exile a creature; you may return it now, and if you don't, it returns at the next end step with counters.

effect:flicker-untargeted-group-delayed-.description: Exile an untargeted group (each creature you control, all creatures, any number chosen) and return them together with one linked delayed return.

effect:look-and-choose-library-total-man.description: A total-mana-value cap (a number or an amount) on `look-and-choose` from the library; only `return-from-graveyard` has `totalManaValueAtMost`.

effect:mana-ability-effect-before-mana.description: A mana ability whose rider happens before the mana is added and sets its amount (put a charge counter, then add X for its charge counters); `add-mana`'s `also` runs after.

effect:mana-spell-gains-permanent-keywor.description: A creature spell cast with this mana gains a keyword for good, not until end of turn (`spellGains` lasts the turn).

effect:move-counters-x-amount.description: `move-counters` moving X counters, X paid for earlier in the resolution; its amount has no X.

effect:prevent-chosen-source-to-attached.description: Prevent damage from a chosen source to the Aura's enchanted creature, read after the Aura is sacrificed for the cost; the effect's `to` takes only 'you' or a target slot.

effect:remove-counter-from-exiled-card.description: 'You may remove a [kind] counter from a card that player owns in exile; if you do, …'.

effect:trigger-spell-gains-keyword.description: A cast trigger giving the spell just cast a keyword that carries to the permanent it becomes ('it gains haste until end of turn').

filter:impulse-permission-spell-face.description: An impulse-exile permission whose filter is judged on the spell as cast (the face chosen), not the exiled card's front face.

trigger:mana-ability-resolves-amount-pro.description: 'Whenever a mana ability of this creature resolves' (granted), carrying the amount of mana produced.

zone:impulse-free-lesser-mana-value-than.description: Each player exiles their top card; you may cast yours free, and each other one only if its mana value is less than yours.

condition:counter-put-on-source-this-tur.description: An intervening-if 'if a counter was put on this permanent this turn' — the turn history has no per-object counters-put list (not the player's counters-put turn stat).

condition:top-card-of-library-matches.description: A static condition on what the top card of your library is ('as long as the top card of your library is black').

cost:ability-cost-reduction-source-power.description: abilityCostModification.reduceGeneric is a fixed number: no 'cost {X} less, where X is this creature's power'.

effect:adapt-ignores-counters.description: Adapt is authored as a conditional add-counter, not an action: nothing can make 'the next time target creature adapts this turn, it adapts as though it had no +1/+1 counters'.

cost:ability-additional-sacrifice-cost.description: A static that adds a non-mana cost ('an additional "Sacrifice a land"') to other permanents' activated abilities.

cost:power-up-cost-reduction.description: abilityCostModification narrows to ninjutsu or unlock only: no 'power-up abilities of other creatures you control cost {3} less'.

cost:first-targeting-ability-cost-reduct.description: 'The first activated ability you activate during your turn that targets a creature you control costs {2} less' — no first-each-turn or target-dependent ability cost reduction.

cost:ability-cost-reduction-targeting-so.description: 'Activated abilities of Equipment you control that target this creature cost {1} less': abilityCostModification can't read the ability's targets.

cost:any-player-mana-ability.description: anyPlayer works for a standalone activation, but another player's mana ability isn't offered to pay their costs (manaSources reads only the payer's permanents).

cost:ability-cost-choice.description: An activated ability with a choice of whole costs ('Pay 2 life or {2}:') — AbilityCost has no options branch like a spell's additionalCost.options.

zone:graveyard-cast-permission-one-use.description: 'You may cast a creature spell from your graveyard this turn' as a one-use permission per resolution (Chainer's ruling): player-effect castFromGraveyard is never used up.

cost:ability-cost-reduction-by-target-st.description: An ability's cost reduced by a number read off its target ('{X} less, where X is the power of the creature it targets', '{1} less for each +1/+1 counter on the creature it targets'): targetCostReduction is a fixed number.

cost:reduction-per-type-shared-with-exil.description: 'Spells you cast cost {1} less for each card type they share with cards exiled with this creature' — no CostReductionAmount reads the spell against the linked exile.

cost:spell-cost-reduction-by-chosen-targ.description: A static cost reduction on other spells keyed to what they target ('spells you cast that target a creature', 'spells that target this creature'): costModification is matched before targets are chosen and has no targets clause.

cost:cost-modification-mana-value-with-x.description: costModification's manaValue filter is read without the chosen X, but a spell's mana value on the stack counts X (Thryx's ruling).

cost:minimum-total-cost.description: A floor on the total cost applied after every other change ('each spell that would cost less than three mana to cast costs three mana').

cost:additional-cost-option-exile-gravey.description: An additionalCost.options branch that exiles cards from the graveyard ('exile two cards from your graveyard or pay {1}{W}'); exileFromGraveyard exists only as a mandatory additional cost.

effect:trigger-object-owner-scope.description: 'Whenever a nonland permanent an opponent owns enters under your control, they lose life' — no PlayerScope names the trigger object's owner.

mana:spend-color-as-another-color.description: spendManaAs is any-color or any-type only: no 'you may spend white mana as though it were red mana'.

mana:spend-only-chosen-color.description: 'Spend only mana of the chosen color to activate this ability' and mana spendable only on monocolored spells of the chosen color.

cost:may-remove-counters-cost.description: A may whose cost removes counters from the source ('you may remove two oil counters from it. If you do, …'): may takes mana, life or energy only.

static:double-triggers-of-spells.description: Trigger doubling that reaches a colorless *spell's* own triggered abilities ('a triggered ability of a colorless spell you control or another colorless permanent'): doubleTriggersOf reads permanents only.

replacement:copy-spell-additional-time.description: A replacement on copying a spell: 'if you would copy a spell one or more times, instead copy it that many times plus an additional time'.

replacement:as-enters-discard-any-number.description: 'As this enters, discard any number of creature cards' with keyword counters by what was discarded — no as-enters discard of a chosen number.

decision:discard-up-to-x.description: 'They may discard up to X cards' with X variable — Kinetic Augur's 0/1/2 modal works only for a small fixed N.

effect:exile-from-hand-any-number-swap.description: Exile any number of cards from your hand face down, put that many from the top of your library into your hand, then put the exiled cards on top in any order.

decision:replacement-order-draw.description: The drawing player orders draw replacements (rule 616.1) — 'skip that draw' against Laboratory Maniac's 'win instead'; the engine applies a fixed order.

decision:replacement-order-damage.description: The affected player (or the affected object's controller) orders damage prevention/protection against another replacement on the same damage (rule 616.1); the engine applies a fixed order.

mana:spent-makes-spell-uncounterable.description: 'If that mana is spent on an instant or sorcery spell, that spell can't be countered' — add-mana's spellGains grants keywords only.

mana:any-type-sacrificed-land-could-prod.description: 'Add one mana of any type the sacrificed land could produce' — no add-mana reading the sacrificed land's mana abilities.

replacement:others-enter-as-subtype.description: An enters replacement for other creatures that adds a creature type as they enter ('and as a Mutant in addition to its other types').

effect:additional-combat-only-in-main-ph.description: 'After this main phase, there is an additional combat phase' adds nothing when resolved outside a main phase (its ruling); additional-combat always adds one.

static:anthem-per-all-counters-on-source.description: grantPtPerCount's countersOnSource counts one kind: no '+X/+X where X is the number of counters on this' over every kind.

amount:total-mana-value-of-targets.description: An amount for the total mana value of an any-number target group ('damage to you equal to the total mana value of those cards').

amount:per-object-controller-player-coun.description: A per-permanent amount read off its own controller ('-1/-1 for each poison counter its controller has').

effect:cast-now-rest-to-graveyard.description: After a 'cast any number from among them' cast-now, put the exiled-this-way cards that weren't cast into the graveyard — cast-now's rest goes only to the library bottom.

effect:no-max-hand-size-while-you-contro.description: A one-shot player effect from a resolving ability, 'you have no maximum hand size for as long as you control this Saga' — a static on the Saga would apply before chapter I resolves and follow a change of control.

cost:mana-ability-discard-cost.description: A mana ability whose cost discards a card ('Discard a card: Add {B}'): the mana-ability path resolves before the discard is paid, so it isn't paid at all.

cost:mana-ability-exile-graveyard-cost.description: A mana ability whose cost exiles a card from your graveyard: refused outright ('mana ability can't exile cards from a graveyard yet').

replacement:damage-multiplier-by-attache.description: A would-deal-damage multiplier whose source is this Aura's (or Equipment's) own host: `source` is a CardFilter and `enchantedBy` matches any Aura you control, so 'if enchanted creature would deal combat damage …, it deals double' can't be scoped.

replacement:combat-damage-becomes-mill.description: A would-deal-damage replacement that replaces combat damage to a player with that player milling that many cards ('instead that player mills that many cards'); prevent's `then` can't name the damaged player.

replacement:enter-exile-if-not-cast.description: An others-enter replacement that exiles a nontoken creature entering without having been cast ('if a nontoken creature would enter and it wasn't cast, exile it instead'): others-enter-battlefield can tap or add counters, not send the permanent elsewhere, and its filter can't ask whether it was cast.

replacement:turn-exile-instead-return-at.description: A resolving spell installs, for the rest of the turn, 'if a permanent you control would be put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it instead' and returns each one so exiled at the beginning of the next end step (turn-exile-if-dies-filter without the return).

replacement:draw-two-or-more-shared.description: A would-draw replacement on an opponent's single draw instruction of two or more cards, replacing it with that player and you each drawing one ('If an opponent would draw two or more cards, instead you and that player each draw a card').

replacement:empty-library-draw-returns-c.description: 'If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, instead return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. If you can't, you lose the game': the empty-library draw replacement can only win the game or redirect the draw.

replacement:opponent-next-draw-becomes-i.description: A delayed would-draw replacement installed on another player for their next draw this turn ('the next time they would draw a card this turn, instead they exile the top card of their library. They may play it this turn').

replacement:chosen-source-shield-you-and.description: 'The next time a source of your choice would deal damage to you and/or creatures you control this turn, prevent that damage', one shield over a player and their creatures, with a follow-up gated on the source's colour (a black source: gain that much life).

replacement:all-hand-spells-exiled-linke.description: A static that exiles every instant or sorcery spell any player cast from their hand as it resolves, linked to this permanent (rule 607.2a) — mandatory, every player's, unlike the optional exile-spell-as-it-resolves-linked.

replacement:token-creation-one-of-each.description: 'If you would create a Clue, Food, or Treasure token, instead create one of each': a token replacement that swaps the token made for a set of named tokens, per token (the rulings: two Manufactors make nine).

stat:countered-spell-mana-spent.description: 'The amount of mana spent to cast that spell' for a spell target after it was countered: manaSpentOf reads the cleared manaSpent off a target that left the stack (only a cast trigger's own spell is read through lastStackManaSpent), and a delayed trigger must carry it.

target:player-dealt-combat-damage-by-n-f.description: A target restriction on a permanent's controller: 'controlled by a player who was dealt combat damage by three or more Pirates this turn' — no per-player record of which creatures dealt them combat damage this turn.

stat:players-dealt-combat-damage-by-name.description: A player scope 'each opponent dealt combat damage this game by a creature named [name]' — a game-long per-player record of the names of creatures that dealt them combat damage.

target:player-dealt-combat-damage-by-sou.description: A player target restricted to one dealt combat damage by this permanent this turn ('target player who was dealt combat damage by Hope of Ghirapur this turn'), the source matched across its sacrifice.

stat:excess-damage-to-departed-this-turn.description: 'If a creature or planeswalker an opponent controlled was dealt excess damage this turn' counting those that have left the battlefield since (the ruling): excessDamageThisTurn is a filter on permanents still there.

amount:damage-dealt-to-object-this-turn.description: An amount: the damage dealt to an object this turn, read as it last existed for a dies trigger ('where X is the amount of damage dealt to it this turn').

stat:spells-cast-before-trigger-spell.description: An amount fixed as a cast trigger triggers: the instant and sorcery spells any player cast this turn before the triggering spell ('1 plus the number of instant and sorcery spells cast before that spell this turn'), not those cast in response later.

stat:searched-library-this-turn.description: A per-player turn record that they searched their library ('if an opponent searched their library this turn' — Archive Trap's {0} alternative cost).

static:cant-attack-lacking-either-keywor.description: 'Creatures without flying or islandwalk can't attack' — a cant-attack static over creatures lacking both of two keywords, read as attackers are declared (one notKeyword per filter, no negated anyOf).

static:grant-replacement-to-commanders.description: A static granting enters-with-counter replacements ('This creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter' and 'Other creatures you control enter with …') to the commander creatures you own, wherever they enter from.

effect:next-spell-has-convoke.description: 'The next spell you cast this turn has convoke' — a one-shot grant of convoke to a player's next spell this turn.

trigger:damage-to-attached-permanent.description: A deals-damage trigger on damage dealt to this Aura's (or Equipment's) own host ('whenever a creature deals damage to enchanted planeswalker'): toFilter is a CardFilter, which can't name the attached permanent.

static:grant-equipment-type-and-equip.description: A static making other permanents Equipment in addition to their other types with granted equip abilities and an equipped-creature bonus ('Treasures you control are Equipment … and have "Equipped creature gets +2/+0," equip Pirate {1}, and equip {3}').

static:pt-per-same-name-as-affected.description: 'Each nontoken creature you control gets +1/+1 for each other creature you control with the same name as that creature': a count keyed on each affected creature's own name.

effect:no-max-hand-size-until-your-next-.description: A one-shot player effect from a resolving spell: 'you have no maximum hand size until your next turn' — noMaxHandSize is only read off permanents.

static:granted-no-max-hand-size.description: 'Enchanted creature has "You have no maximum hand size"': a granted static whose 'you' is the enchanted creature's controller, not the Aura's.

static:pt-per-defending-player-count.description: A static +X/+0 while attacking, X counted over the defending player's permanents ('where X is the number of lands defending player controls'): grantPtPerCount counts from its controller's side.

static:set-base-pt-to-life-total.description: A layer-7b base P/T set to a live amount ('equipped creature has base power and toughness X/X, where X is your life total'): setBasePt takes fixed numbers only.

static:double-triggers-on-leaves.description: A doubleTriggers cause for a matching permanent leaving the battlefield ('a legendary permanent or an artifact entering or leaving the battlefield'): the causes cover entering and dying, not leaving.

static:suppress-enter-and-dies-triggers.description: 'Creatures entering or dying don't cause abilities to trigger' — suppressEntryTriggers covers permanents entering under opponents only, not creatures dying, nor all players' abilities.

static:granted-dies-trigger-doubling.description: A trigger doubler granted to the equipped creature: 'If a creature dying causes a triggered ability of this creature or an emblem you own to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time' — doubleTriggers reaches permanents you control, not one creature's own abilities and your emblems.

static:double-triggers-of-attached.description: 'If a triggered ability of equipped creature triggers, that ability triggers an additional time': doubleTriggersOf can't name the Equipment's host.

static:double-attack-triggers-your-attac.description: The attack-cause trigger doubler narrowed to a creature you control attacking ('If a creature you control attacking causes …'): Isshin's form doubles for any attacker, and a filter drops the whole-declaration triggers.

trigger:artifact-tapped-or-untapped-cost.description: 'Whenever an artifact becomes tapped or a player activates an artifact's ability without {T} in its activation cost' — an activates-ability trigger over any player's artifacts narrowed to costs without {T}, beside a becomes-tapped trigger.

trigger:activates-ability-from-graveyard.description: 'Whenever you … activate an ability of a card in your graveyard': activates-ability only watches permanents.

trigger:activates-loyalty-ability-cost-s.description: 'Whenever you activate a loyalty ability, if you removed two or more loyalty counters to activate it': the ability-activated event carries no loyalty cost.

filter:origin-other-than-hand.description: 'From anywhere other than your hand' on a land-played, land-entered or spell-cast trigger: plays-card has a from zone but no 'not from', and a token land 'entered from' nowhere still counts.

filter:cast-using-teamwork.description: A cast-spell filter for a spell cast using teamwork (rule 702.194b): teamwork is modelled as a kicker, and `kicked` matches any kicked spell.

trigger:damage-batch-over-opponents.description: One trigger for 'one or more Pirates you control deal damage to your opponents' acting on each of those opponents ('exile the top card of each of those opponents' libraries'): deals-damage-batch fires once per player.

mechanic:opening-hand-reveal.description: Reveal a card from the opening hand for a delayed ability at the first upkeep or main phase (rule 103.6b): CardDefinition.openingHandReveal, built 2026-10-28 (B240). Not a cast-keyed delayed trigger (Chancellor of the Annex) nor Gemstone Caverns' begin-with-a-counter.

trigger:opponent-first-spell-of-game.description: An opening-hand reveal's delayed trigger on each opponent's first spell of the game, lasting past turn 1 (DelayedWhenever lapses with the turn).

mechanic:opening-hand-not-starting-playe.description: Begin the game on the battlefield only if you're not the starting player, with a luck counter, exiling a card from your hand (beginsOnBattlefield is unconditional and does nothing else).

cost:cumulative-upkeep-non-mana.description: A cumulative upkeep cost that isn't mana, life or a sacrifice (put counters on it), paid as a cost and so unpayable when impossible; unless options have no add-counter payment.

cost:cumulative-upkeep-gain-control-land.description: Cumulative upkeep paid by gaining control of a different land you don't control per age counter; no unless option gains control.

cost:cumulative-upkeep-graveyard-to-libr.description: Cumulative upkeep paid by putting two cards from a single graveyard on the bottom of their owner's library per age counter.

cost:cumulative-upkeep-opponent-gains-li.description: Cumulative upkeep paid by an opponent (chosen per age counter) gaining life; no unless option for it.

effect:create-tokens-distributed-among-o.description: N tokens created for opponents, each token's controller chosen separately (create-token gives all N to one player or to each opponent).

cost:multikicker-not-kicker.description: 'As an additional cost, you may pay [cost] any number of times' with no keyword name: a bare multi kicker would count as kicked.

effect:copy-exception-changeling.description: A copy exception granting changeling that subtype reads honour (withChangeling reads only the definition's keywords).

effect:exile-graveyard-linked.description: exile-graveyard whose exiled cards are linked to the source for a later 'exiled with' ability.

filter:has-modular.description: A filter for creatures with modular (modular is authored as a replacement plus a dies trigger, with no keyword marker).

cost:replicate-tap-permanent.description: A replicate cost of tapping an untapped permanent you control (kicker costs are mana strings).

cost:replicate-energy.description: A replicate cost paid in energy (kicker costs are mana strings).

trigger:solves-case.description: 'Whenever you solve a Case' (solve is only an effect, with no trigger).

static:grant-miracle-in-hand.description: A static giving cards in your hand miracle, at a fixed cost or their mana cost reduced (miracle is only a printed card field).

cost:cumulative-upkeep-add-mana.description: Cumulative upkeep paid by adding mana ('Cumulative upkeep—Add {R}'); no unless option adds mana.

static:grant-cumulative-upkeep.description: A static granting cumulative upkeep to a set of permanents ('Green creatures have cumulative upkeep {1}'); cumulative upkeep is a printed or one-off granted trigger only.

cost:cumulative-upkeep-counter-on-oppone.description: Cumulative upkeep paid by putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, chosen per age counter without targeting.

cost:cumulative-upkeep-exile-library-top.description: Cumulative upkeep paid by exiling the top card of your library per age counter.

trigger:cumulative-upkeep-not-paid.description: 'When a player doesn't pay this permanent's cumulative upkeep' as its own trigger (Heart of Bogardan's is written as a reflexive trigger inside the unless's otherwise).

keyword:warp-from-graveyard-and-life-cos.description: Warp cast from the graveyard, with a cost that includes paying life (warp is { cost: string } from the hand only).

bug:reflexive-target-trigger-player.description: A reflexive trigger's card-in-graveyard target with whose: 'trigger-player' finds no legal targets, though the parent's lastKnownRefs hold the player (whose: 'any' works): 'when you do, cast target card from defending player's graveyard'.

filter:has-activated-ability.description: A card filter for 'with activated abilities' (craft materials 'nonlands with activated abilities').

static:granted-linked-abilities-once-eac.description: Granted abilities of linked exiled cards, each activatable only once each turn.

cost:cumulative-upkeep-discard.description: Cumulative upkeep paid by discarding a card per age counter (the unless discard option has no times).

filter:has-embalm-or-eternalize.description: A card filter for 'a creature card with eternalize or embalm'.

trigger:activates-embalm-or-eternalize.description: 'Whenever you activate an eternalize or embalm ability' (activates-ability can't narrow to them).

effect:shuffle-self-into-library-top.description: Exile it and the top N cards of your library in a face-down pile, shuffle that pile and put it back on top.

effect:reattach-curse-random-opponent.description: Moving an Aura onto another opponent chosen at random ('then attach this Aura to another one of your opponents chosen at random').

effect:extra-loyalty-activations-this-tu.description: A one-shot 'you may activate [this]'s loyalty ability N more times this turn'.

decision:choose-creature-or-player-on-re.description: Damage to 'a creature or player' chosen as the ability resolves, not targeted.

condition:roll-result-compare.description: A condition on a roll's results against an amount: how many dice showed a number ('if you rolled 6 exactly seven times'), or the result against the trigger's damage ('if the result is greater than the damage dealt').

replacement:roll-as-enters.description: 'As this creature enters, roll X d6; it enters with that many +1/+1 counters': an enters-with-counters replacement that rolls.

condition:trigger-object-greatest-power.description: 'If it has the greatest power or is tied for greatest power among creatures on the battlefield' about the trigger's creature (the equipped one), across every controller.

trigger:rolls-dice-modified-result.description: A rolls-dice trigger whose value is the result after modifiers (rule 706.2), not the natural total.

target:stack-with-targets.description: 'Target spell or ability with one or more targets': the stack target can require that the object has a target.

trigger:enchanted-player-dealt-damage.description: 'Whenever enchanted player is dealt damage' — any damage, not only combat (trigger:combat-damage-to-enchanted-player is combat-only).

filter:dealt-combat-damage-to-you-this-t.description: A filter for 'a creature that dealt combat damage to you this turn' (damagedThisTurnBy covers the receiving end only).

replacement:damage-plus-counters-on-sour.description: A damage replacement's plus read from counters on the replacement's source ('plus the number of fire counters on this enchantment'); plus is a fixed number.

effect:grant-replacement-until-eot.description: Granting a creature a replacement ability until end of turn ('target creature gains "If this creature would deal combat damage to a player, prevent that damage …"').

effect:additional-upkeep-step-enchanted-.description: An additional upkeep step for another player, added during their upkeep ('at the beginning of enchanted player's first upkeep each turn, that player gets an additional upkeep step after this step').

effect:lose-all-player-counters.description: 'Each opponent loses all counters': every kind at once, energy included (remove-player-counters takes one kind and excludes energy).

effect:goad-while-source-remains.description: A creature goaded 'as long as this enchantment remains on the battlefield'.

effect:time-counters-on-all-suspended.description: Adding or removing N time counters on each permanent (with a time counter) and each suspended card at once.

condition:hand-land-card-count.description: 'If you have seven or more land cards in your hand': hand-size with a card filter.

target:creature-attacking-you-player-onl.description: A target 'creature attacking you' that excludes creatures attacking your planeswalkers (the `creature-attacking-you` spec admits both).
target:creature-attacking-you-player-onl.example: Lulu, Stern Guardian: 'choose target creature attacking you' — only creatures attacking the player (the ruling), and the spec also admits ones attacking your planeswalkers.

trigger:counters-put-any-kind-once.description: 'Whenever you put one or more counters on a creature' of any kind, once per permanent per event: counters-put fires once per kind, so proliferating a creature with two kinds triggers twice.
trigger:counters-put-any-kind-once.example: Generous Patron: 'Whenever you put one or more counters on a creature you don't control' — counters-put fires once per counter kind, so mixed kinds on one creature would trigger twice.

effect:delayed-whenever-about-target.description: An until-end-of-turn delayed 'whenever' trigger about a target of the creating spell ('whenever that creature is dealt damage this turn'), with that creature as the damage source; DelayedWheneverWatch can only name the creating object.
effect:delayed-whenever-about-target.example: Arcbond: 'Whenever that creature is dealt damage this turn, it deals that much damage to each other creature and each player' — no delayed whenever watch about the target creature.

static:pt-per-opponent.description: A static P/T bonus per opponent you have (grantPtPerCount has no player count).
static:pt-per-opponent.example: Blazing Sunsteel: 'Equipped creature gets +1/+0 for each opponent you have' — grantPtPerCount counts no players.

trigger:combat-damage-to-you-or-your-pla.description: 'Whenever combat damage is dealt to you or a planeswalker you control', once per combat damage event: deals-damage-batch's `to: "you"` covers only the player.
trigger:combat-damage-to-you-or-your-pla.example: Vengeful Pharaoh: 'Whenever combat damage is dealt to you or a planeswalker you control' (once per event) — deals-damage-batch reaches players only.

trigger:deals-damage-to-recipients-once-.description: 'Whenever this deals damage to one or more creatures / blocking creatures', once per damage event: a deals-damage trigger that names a recipient fires once per recipient (the once-per-event form is only for no recipient named).
trigger:deals-damage-to-recipients-once-.example: Arashin War Beast: 'deals combat damage to one or more blocking creatures' triggers once per combat damage step; deals-damage with a recipient fires once per recipient.

filter:creature-or-spell-source.description: A deals-damage source filter for 'a red creature or spell': a creature permanent or any spell on the stack, never a noncreature permanent (Justice).
filter:creature-or-spell-source.example: Justice: 'Whenever a red creature or spell deals damage' — no filter reads 'a creature or a spell'; a color filter alone also matches a red noncreature permanent.

trigger:nth-each-turn-during-own-turn.description: 'Whenever a player draws their second card / casts their second spell during their turn' — nthEachTurn with the actor being the active player.
trigger:nth-each-turn-during-own-turn.example: The Council of Four: a player's second draw / second spell during their own turn; nthEachTurn counts any turn.

trigger:self-put-into-graveyard-from-lib.description: 'When this card is put into your graveyard from your library' — a self trigger of the card in the graveyard (Gaea's Blessing, Kozilek's Return-style mill triggers).
trigger:self-put-into-graveyard-from-lib.example: Gaea's Blessing: 'When this card is put into your graveyard from your library, shuffle your graveyard into your library.'

trigger:state-trigger-per-permanent.description: A state trigger about each permanent matching a filter, with that permanent as the trigger object ('whenever a creature has four or more fuse counters on it, … destroy it'); on: "state" takes only a StaticCondition about the source.
trigger:state-trigger-per-permanent.example: Bomb Squad: 'Whenever a creature has four or more fuse counters on it, remove all fuse counters from it and destroy it.'

effect:grant-state-trigger-to-returned-c.description: A creature put onto the battlefield that gains a state trigger ('It gains "When you don't control a legendary Vampire, exile this creature"'): put-onto-battlefield grants nothing, and a granted on: "state" trigger is unproven.
effect:grant-state-trigger-to-returned-c.example: Olivia, Crimson Bride: the returned creature gains 'When you don't control a legendary Vampire, exile this creature.'

trigger:attacks-you-unblocked-batch.description: 'Whenever one or more creatures an opponent controls attack you and aren't blocked' — once per attacking player per blockers step; attacks-unblocked fires once per attacker.
trigger:attacks-you-unblocked-batch.example: Coveted Jewel: 'that player draws three cards and gains control of this artifact' once per batch of unblocked attackers.

zone:exile-library-bottom-face-down-cast.description: Exile the bottom card of each opponent's library face down with a lookable, cast-permanent-spells-while-exiled, any-color permission (Arvinox).
zone:exile-library-bottom-face-down-cast.example: Arvinox, the Mind Flail: bottom card of each opponent's library exiled face down, castable permanent spells with any-color mana; and 'isn't a creature unless you control three or more permanents you don't own'.

zone:exile-maycast-exile-instead.description: An exile with a cast-this-turn permission whose spell is exiled instead of going to a graveyard (exile's mayCast has no exile-instead rider).
zone:exile-maycast-exile-instead.example: Dire Fleet Daredevil: cast the exiled card this turn with any-type mana, and if that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.

effect:search-opponent-library-exile-pla.description: Search another player's library for a card, exile it, that player shuffles, and you may play it this turn.
effect:search-opponent-library-exile-pla.example: Thada Adel, Acquisitor: search that player's library for an artifact card, exile it, play it until end of turn.

zone:plot-from-library-top.description: Granting plot to the top card of your library (plot cost = its mana cost) and plotting from there.
zone:plot-from-library-top.example: Fblthp, Lost on the Range: the top card of your library has plot; you may plot nonland cards from the top of your library.

cost:pay-life-equal-mv-instead-of-mana.description: An alternative cost 'pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost' for spells cast through a permission.
cost:pay-life-equal-mv-instead-of-mana.example: Gwenom, Remorseless: cards played from the top of the library this turn; spells cast this way cost life equal to their mana value.

effect:exile-library-face-down.description: Exile a whole library face down (exile-from-library has no faceDown).
effect:exile-library-face-down.example: Inverter of Truth: exile all cards from your library face down, then shuffle your graveyard into your library.

effect:look-opponent-library-exile-one-f.description: Look at the top N of another player's library, exile one face down with a cast-while-exiled any-type permission, the rest into their graveyard.
effect:look-opponent-library-exile-one-f.example: Thief of Sanity: top three of that player's library, one exiled face down castable while exiled, the rest into their graveyard.

effect:look-exile-face-down-cast-while-e.description: look-and-choose to exile-face-down with a standing 'you may cast it for as long as it remains exiled if it's a [type] spell' permission (cast-now is during resolution only).
effect:look-exile-face-down-cast-while-e.example: Vivien, Champion of the Wilds: −2 exiles one of the top three face down; you may cast it while it remains exiled if it's a creature spell.

zone:exile-owner-may-cast-now.description: 'For as long as that card remains exiled, its owner may cast it' starting at once (allow-cast-from-exile's laterTurns starts next turn; exile's mayCast is the controller's).
zone:exile-owner-may-cast-now.example: Aerial Extortionist: exile up to one target nonland permanent; its owner may cast it for as long as it remains exiled.

effect:exile-chosen-from-revealed-hand-m.description: Exile a card you choose from an opponent's revealed hand, with a gift-conditional cast-while-exiled any-type permission.
effect:exile-chosen-from-revealed-hand-m.example: Cruelclaw's Heist: you choose a nonland card from target opponent's revealed hand and exile it; if the gift was promised, you may cast it while it remains exiled.

zone:impulse-until-your-next-turn-begins.description: An impulse duration 'until your next turn' that ends as your next turn begins (`your-next-turn` lasts until it ends).
zone:impulse-until-your-next-turn-begins.example: Nivix, Aerie of the Firemind: until your next turn, you may cast it if it's an instant or sorcery spell.

zone:exile-trigger-object-play-this-turn.description: Exile the trigger object with a play (lands included) permission this turn: exile's mayCast is cast-only.
zone:exile-trigger-object-play-this-turn.example: Norin, Swift Survivalist: exile the blocked creature; you may play that card from exile this turn (a land creature card included).

zone:shared-impulse-pool-each-player.description: Cards exiled with a permanent that each player may play from during their own turn (one land or spell each time, any-color mana), re-exiling on use; and a 'whenever an opponent loses the game' trigger.
zone:shared-impulse-pool-each-player.example: Share the Spoils: each player may play a land or cast a spell from among cards exiled with it during their turn, then exiles their top card.

zone:play-milled-card-this-turn.description: 'Mill a card. You may play that card this turn' — a play (lands included) permission on a card in the graveyard.
zone:play-milled-card-this-turn.example: Tablet of Discovery: mill a card; you may play that card this turn.

zone:cast-from-exiled-with-source-enters.description: A standing permission to cast Dinosaur creature spells from among cards you own exiled with this, entering with a finality counter.
zone:cast-from-exiled-with-source-enters.example: Intrepid Paleontologist: cast Dinosaurs from among cards you own exiled with it; each enters with a finality counter.

trigger:granted-trigger-condition-look-b.description: A condition gating a granted leaves-the-battlefield trigger (threshold's 'as long as seven or more cards …, this has "whenever a creature is put into your graveyard …"') asked as things were just before the event (rule 603.10a): today it's asked after, so the creature that makes the seventh card triggers it.
trigger:granted-trigger-condition-look-b.example: Decaying Soil: the threshold-granted dies trigger fires for the creature that makes the seventh card (tested), against the ruling.

effect:cast-now-once-each-turn-if-cast.description: A cast-now offer limited to once each turn, the turn's use spent only when the card is actually cast ('look at the top card … you may cast it … Do this only once each turn').
effect:cast-now-once-each-turn-if-cast.example: Planetarium of Wan Shi Tong: whenever you scry or surveil, look at the top card and you may cast it free, only once each turn — spent only by a cast.

groups.shape: a count condition over attachments on the source: 'N or more <type> attached to it', with the attachment type and N as parameters
a reference to the permanent the source is attached to (its host), usable in a static condition on the host's state and in a CardFilter clause comparing or excluding the host
a condition that a creature you control has an attached permanent matching a CardFilter (legendary, named X)
a CardFilter clause 'attached to <host>' where the host is a chosen object (target slot) or a player
One CardFilter clause 'has the same name as a reference' (this source, a chosen object, the triggering spell, a card in a graveyard, or any permanent optionally matching a filter F).
Widen the built sameNameAsTarget's scope: namesakes in graveyard, hand or library, and the target plus same-named tokens only.
Per-turn record of cards put into any graveyard from anywhere, read as a CardFilter clause on graveyard cards plus a turn count stat.
CardFilter 'has an activated ability' with an optional cost filter (not a mana ability; cost includes {T}).
CardFilter clauses on a card's face state: transformed (back face up) and double-faced (has a back face).
CardFilter 'has named ability X' reading that ability's own field, in the style of the built has-adventure and has-toxic clauses.
Attacking/attacked filter with a defender field set to you, for current combat or this turn's attack history.
CardFilter 'is a blocked creature' (blocked since blockers were declared), usable in a target or each-filter.
CardFilter colour-count clause 'exactly N colours' with N a literal or computed amount, optionally negated.
CardFilter 'dealt damage this turn' with the recipient (anything or creatures) and a combat-only option.

one filter, shares a type of a kind (creature, card or land type) with a reference object: the enchanted creature, a target slot, or a sacrificed or exiled object from the cost; the land variant reads a set of controlled lands and may be negated
an intervening-if whose comparison takes a dynamic amount operand (mana spent, a count of attackers, a live maximum over controlled permanents), re-read on resolution

One per-player number (hand size, life, or a count matching a filter) compared against every or some other player's, as a controller condition or a max-player scope, with a direction and a ties-included-or-strict flag.
Extend the built life operand of player-state-thresholds to take a starting-life reference plus or minus a fixed N (at least starting plus 7, at least starting total).

A state predicate (hand size, a zone empty, life total, poison counters) read on a player bound by the effect (target slot, trigger's that-player, for-each iteration, or defending player) rather than only you or the opponent.
A turn-stat threshold (life lost this turn, at least N) read on a player bound by a target slot or a for-each iteration, with turn-stat's who extended to that bound player.
A threshold of N or more distinct values (card types in a graveyard, counter kinds on a filtered set of permanents), each value counted once across the scope.
A cards-in-graveyard count condition with a scope (yours or every graveyard) and an option to leave out the card being cast from that graveyard.
A count of permanents matching a filter over a player scope (you, or every player), tested as a threshold or as prime.
A combat-history read: whether a player attacked you last turn, or was dealt combat damage this turn by a filtered source.
abilityCostModification takes an ability-kind predicate (equip, exhaust, cycling, loyalty) alongside its source filter; loyalty also needs a non-mana loyalty-cost change for Carth
an activated ability's own costReduction takes a condition and a coloured-mana amount, not generic-only and unconditional
an alternative cost of {0} for the first activation of a named ability kind each turn (equip, power-up)
abilityCostModification's source filter widens to the ability's zone (hand and graveyard too) or to the enchanted/attached creature
a cost exiling a count of graveyard cards (fixed, optional, or X announced with the spell or ability), with the exiled cards readable by the effect (power, mana value, or a reference to them)
a cost exiling any number of chosen cards matching a filter until a summed or counted threshold is met (total mana symbols of a color, total mana value, or distinct card types)
a discard cost of a count (fixed, X, or a same-name group) of cards matching a filter, chosen by the caster from their hand

CostReductionAmount gains more count sources read like countOf: an excludeSelf flag for other permanents, distinct colours among permanents, creatures attacking the caster, all counters on players and permanents, cards with the same name in a zone, and a sum of two such counts.
CostReductionAmount counts a per-turn history record (creatures died, permanents sacrificed, energy paid or lost), read like turnHistory with a controller filter.
CostReductionAmount counts opponents that match a combat condition (dealt damage, attacked) as a per-opponent count.
CostReductionAmount reads the power of a permanent: the source itself, or the creature an Equipment is attached to.
selfCostReduction reduces coloured pips and a per-unit amount N, and takes more than one independent reduction with its own conditions.
A cost increase or modification keyed on the spell's chosen targets: applied before reductions when a target matches, and counted per target that is a creature only.
A cost reduction (or increase) that applies only to one cast variant (kicked, or flashback), gated by that variant.
A flashback's non-mana cost (tap untapped creatures, or discard cards) read from the flashback definition and paid like the tapOthers or discard additional cost.
A sacrifice cost whose count or filter is computed: all of a type, half the lands rounded up, or a permanent with mana value X.
costModification's spell filter gains the zone a spell is cast from (graveyard, exile) and a commander-cast count.
one selection of cards drawn from several zones at once (hand, graveyard, library top), with an optional whole-selection rule such as one per card or creature type, a count, or all-different names
untargeted pick from graveyards: one card from any graveyard, one per player's graveyard, or one from an opponent's graveyard, with an optional card-type filter
any-number choice whose chosen set must have all-different values of one attribute (power or name), checked over the whole selection
choose a card in exile (face-up, owned by a named player, optionally filtered by name) and move it to another zone
search across library, graveyard and hand with one zone list, an up-to-N count that may be zero, and no forced minimum when a match exists in a graveyard

One untargeted choice of permanents by a named chooser, with a count (fixed or variable minimum) and an exclusion filter (another than the trigger object or source), at resolution or as it enters; the chosen permanent is remembered for later statics and abilities.

Per category (basic land type, card type, or color), the player chooses one card or permanent from a zone, one object may fill several categories, then the chosen set is kept or acted on and the unchosen rest is sacrificed or discarded.
Each player in APNAP order chooses a subset of their objects to keep, by count, by total power, or one per opponent, and the unchosen rest is sacrificed, exiled or otherwise affected as a group.

For each player (or each opponent), the controller or that player chooses one untargeted permanent or card they control or own in a zone, the chosen ones are acted on together, and a predicate may decide what happens to the rest.
A resolution-time choice of one of the resolving spell's or ability's still-legal targets, or a choice that keeps the spell's existing targets for its then-clause instead of replacing them.
a sum of the last-known power of a set of creatures that died together or this turn; the window (one event or this turn) is the parameter
the greatest mana value among the cards a just-resolved effect moved (discarded or milled), read after the move; the move verb is the parameter
a greatest or total of one stat over a filtered card set, with the set's source as the parameter: battlefield, a graveyard or union of zones, an attack batch, or a target player's permanents
a sum over every counter kind (not one named kind) on permanents matching a filter, with an optional target player as the filter's controller
EffectAmount counting the creatures blocking a named object: the source, or the trigger object (a per-blocker amount on either).
A player scope on the count amounts (creature cards in a graveyard, cards in a hand): a target slot, or each player in an each-player effect.
countOf takes its player from a reference (the trigger's player, the damaged player, a target slot, or a chosen player) as one player argument.
A count of players (or opponents) satisfying a per-player predicate: controls more lands, controls a matching permanent, life below a bound, has lost, or graveyard holds N or more cards.
A count of creatures sharing a creature type: the greatest group among your creatures, or those sharing a type with a given object.
EffectAmount: the number of distinct values of one property (mana value, power, name, subtype, card type, counter kind, colour, colour pair) among objects in a zone set matching a filter.
An EffectAmount reading a referenced object's power, base power or toughness, last-known if it has left.
basicLandTypes with a player argument: the basic land types among lands a target or chosen player controls, instead of only yours.
A rounding or division transform on an amount: a third rounded up, or every N divided and rounded down.
The greatest or chosen commander's mana value over a zone set (battlefield and command zone, or any), with the player choosing among several commanders.
Attach target picked among the just-created tokens by a selector, either the controller's choice on resolution or a filter/position rule, instead of the engine's default pick.
A for-each over a set of objects where each iteration creates or attaches a token or Equipment to that iteration's object (the attach target is the loop object).

One put-onto-battlefield-with-attach-target: an Aura or Equipment card from hand, graveyard or a library search enters attached to a permanent or player named by self, a target, the trigger object, or a resolution choice.
Attach an Aura to a permanent chosen on resolution by a chooser (its controller, or another player), limited to permanents the Aura can enchant, with no targeting.
A reference to the set of Equipment or Auras attached to an object, current or last-known after it left, usable as an effect's object to unattach or re-attach.

become-copy takes a general duration condition: until a turn boundary (your next turn, which also allows a creature-card-in-graveyard or exile target), for as long as the source stays attached, or for as long as another permanent stays tapped.

become-copy whose source is a named card or last-known object outside the battlefield (graveyard, library, exile, or a sacrificed creature), referenced by a chosen or linked card rather than a battlefield permanent.
castAsThoughFlash generalised to a grantee (any player) and a duration or count (this turn, next spell, first creature spell each turn)
castAsThoughFlash with a condition, read from the card's own state or from its target
prohibits.abilitiesOf takes an ability-kind filter (non-mana, loyalty) instead of being all-or-nothing
player-level prohibition on playing lands and on casting from a named zone, covering lands and zone-filtered spells, not only spells and abilities
per-turn cap on spells cast by each player, with an optional spell filter and a per-player condition
a cast prohibition with a duration of until your next turn, with an optional spell filter
prohibits.abilitiesOf names a permanent reference (attached, the ability's source, or the target) plus an optional ability-kind filter, instead of a filter alone
prohibit spells sharing a color with a dynamic reference (the chosen color, or the last spell cast this turn)
activation count or prohibition for power-up abilities as a static on them, with a turn condition
prohibits.spells scoped to a player set chosen by a condition (attacked you, each opponent, or compared with you), with an optional timing clause
cast-now takes a cost override or extra cost: a fixed alternative mana cost, life equal to the spell's mana value in place of its mana cost, or an extra cost paid on top of its other costs.
cast-now's from takes a set of zones and a player selector (you, a target player, or each opponent, one cast per chosen player) instead of one fixed zone of the caster.
a named counter kind on exiled cards: an exile step that puts a card in exile with a counter, and a cast-now (or copy-and-cast) whose cards are filtered to those carrying that counter.
cast-now's destination can be the bottom of the library (a spell that would hit the graveyard goes there instead, or the cards not cast from a looked-at top N go there).
a targeted player (or each opponent) chooses N cards from their own hand and the cards go to exile or to the top of their library; the player scope and destination are parameters
each player makes a choice in turn order (optionally face down, with the choice kind as a parameter), then every chosen object is acted on at once
one or more chooser(s) keep the chosen permanents and every unchosen permanent is destroyed (or otherwise acted on) at once
a chooser other than the controller picks N permanents from a set (their own or the controller's) and the controller's effect acts on the picked permanents
a chooser other than the controller picks the target(s) or the mode of a spell or ability, with the chooser as a parameter
another player picks one or N cards from a set the controller revealed, found, exiled or holds, and the rest go where the effect sends them
a chooser other than the controller picks a card from a graveyard (its owner's or the controller's) and the card is returned, exiled or moved
a may whose answer comes from a chosen player or from any one opponent, with the answerer as a parameter, and the yes/no result changing the effect
for each object in a set, its controller (or each opponent) pays a cost or else takes a consequence, asked per object with the pay and the consequence as parameters
a single unless clause: a named player may pay a cost (generic, per counter, life, or a sacrifice or exile option) and the effect happens only if they do not
an opponent guesses a property of a hidden card (mana value or card kind) and the result depends on whether the guess was right
each affected opponent chooses one of two offered outcomes, asked in turn order, with the choice as a parameter
exchange control of a set of objects: two targeted creatures, or all creatures matching a filter with a target opponent (one exchange over a chosen object set)
gain control for as long as a condition holds (a counter is present, the creature is enchanted, a named Aura stays attached), ending when the condition stops holding

control change whose recipient is computed at resolution: the trigger's controller, the damage recipient, the player with the most of a type, a seat-relative player, or each of a set of objects to a different opponent
copy-spell option that changes the copy itself: override a characteristic (not legendary, an extra type, a 1/1 body) or grant the copy abilities such as haste and an end-step sacrifice trigger
copy-spell whose copy is controlled by a player other than the caster (an opponent or the targeted player), who may choose the copy's new targets

copy-spell that makes one copy per object in a counted or chosen set (creatures the spell could target, chosen objects with a cost per copy, permanents put into a graveyard this turn), each copy with its own target

copy-spell whose copy targets a chosen object the spell could target instead of the original target, optionally behind an intervening-if on another opponent's permanents or the spell's could-target set

one 'until the end of your next turn' / 'until your next turn' duration parameter threaded through gain-control, restrict and animate effects, so each accepts the duration the built duration-extensions key added for P/T and type grants

exile with a general end condition: the exiled card returns to its owner when a named condition happens (source leaves, a player becomes monarch, another target leaves), with the condition as a parameter of the exile duration
a one-shot effect on another permanent whose duration is tied to the source's state (stays tapped, or stays controlled by you), ending when that state ends instead of at end of turn
a controller-of-target player recipient, resolved from the target object, usable by discard, draw, amass and counter effects
a controlledByTarget scope on the all-creatures effects (grant-keyword-all, restrict, damage-all), with damage-all also taking a target planeswalker's controller
a per-player could-not-discard branch usable by per-opponent effects and as an edict's per-player fallback
a step-begins trigger whose subject is the attached creature's controller or the active player, with that player bound for the effect's 'that player'
Put a set of cards exiled with the source onto the battlefield: all of them, or all but the one just exiled, optionally with withCounters.
Put-onto-battlefield (and look-and-choose enterAs) adding colours, card types and subtypes in addition to the printed ones, optionally gated on being a creature as it enters, and setting base P/T.
withCounters on put-onto-battlefield gated on a condition judged as the permanent enters, with the count fixed, equal to X, or equal to lands you control.
withCounters takes a computed amount (last-known count minus one, or X) and a list of counter kinds rather than one fixed number and one kind.
reveal-until with a stop condition other than the first match: stop after a count of matching cards, or after a running total of mana value reaches a bound.
reveal-until's whose-library choice also accepts each opponent or the source's owner, and the cards it reveals can be linked to the source for a later ability.
A target spec for a creature blocking (or blocked by) a named object: the source, or an Equipment's or Aura's host, as a filter on the target slot.
A multi-card target slot with a graveyard scope: one graveyard shared by all targets, or a named player's graveyard (target player, damaged player, or another target's controller).
A target spec over cards in one or two zones (exile, graveyard, battlefield) with a filter, optionally limited to cards the creating effect just put there.
One target slot per opponent, optional ('up to one') or required, skipped for a seat with no legal target.
One target slot over players, planeswalkers and creatures, each part with its own optional filter (any target with a filter is the one-part case).
A constraint relating the chosen targets to one another (same controller, shared creature type, equal toughness, different names), checked over the whole target group.
A reveal-from-hand effect: the whole hand, up to N chosen cards, or one at random, from your hand or a target or that player's hand, with a follow-on over the revealed set.
A player reference resolving to the owner (not the controller) of a target or trigger object, usable by a later step such as discard or exile graveyard.
One target slot over a spell and another object kind (an ability or a creature), each part with its own filter.
a cost reduction on the next matching spell cast this turn or until your next turn, instances cumulative; the spell filter and the duration are parameters.
a one-use free-cast permission on the next spell you cast this turn matching a filter (color and creature type, or a chosen card type), castable from any zone.
a player-level attack prohibition against you and your permanents, with the duration as a parameter (this turn, or that player's next turn).
a player-level keyword grant (protection from a chosen color, or hexproof) with a duration parameter, extending the built player-protection and the player hexproof grant.
a player-level spell-cost increase with a duration (this turn or until your next turn) and an affected-player filter (opponents, or any player).
a player-level can't-gain-life effect on a target player, with the duration as a parameter (rest of the game, or this turn).
a turn-scoped replacement effect installed on a player by a resolving effect, parameterized by the replaced event (draw, put counters, or enter tapped).
a this-way kind for cards a resolution moved into a hand, recorded per source zone (library search, exile, mill) and read by a following effect
a this-way kind for counters removed or put by an earlier step, readable as an amount or as a filter on the objects it touched
an EffectAmount counting the cards a prior this-way step revealed, shuffled or kept on top
create a token copy of a card an earlier step moved (destroyed, discarded, exiled), via a this-way reference to that card as it last existed
a this-way kind for permanents an earlier step moved to a new controller or back onto the battlefield, so a following grant (untap, haste) reaches exactly those
a put-into-library effect with a top-or-bottom destination (controller's choice or fixed bottom), applied to a this-way or linked set of cards
a this-way reference to the objects a create or manifest step put onto the battlefield, usable as the target of a later counter effect
a condition reading which branch of a prior step (a sacrifice, an additional-cost option) was actually performed
last-known-information amount: read a this-way card's mana value or power from its last-known state after it has left the battlefield or hand
a this-way condition over the card types of the cards an earlier step affected (sacrificed, milled), with a count or share-all comparison
a this-way kind for cards drawn by a resolution, used both as an amount and as a trigger condition
Extra selection options on create-token-copy's { each } filter: leave out the effect's source, and restrict to objects controlled by a targeted player.

create-token-copy with a linked source: the card exiled with this (as a cost or by a Saga chapter) or the creature it is attached to, copying nothing if that object has already left; the other per-card extras stay separate.
create-token-copy over cards taken from a zone other than the battlefield (a graveyard, or cards revealed by each player), with copy exceptions for the copies' P/T.
a morph/disguise turn-face-up cost that is not plain mana, is {X}, or is adjusted by a static or a live count as it is paid
exile a card face down into a zone linked to the source with no play permission, the card taken from a library top or chosen by a search
return or put a card onto the battlefield face down, as a fixed choice, a controller's choice, or after an exile
turn a face-down permanent face up by an effect, plus a static that forbids turning permanents face up under a condition
manifest or cloak with a choosable source: a card from a hand, another player's library, a shuffled exiled pile, or a look-and-choose selection

copyOnEnter whose source is a creature card in exile or a graveyard, narrowed by a filter (a takeover counter on it, or having been put there from the battlefield this turn); extends copy-on-enter-options' zone source.

CopyExceptions that are dynamic or conditional rather than fixed: a P/T copied from the copier, an exception that applies only when a condition holds (embalmed), and added card types and abilities (Vehicle, crew).
one-shot delayed enter replacement: the next matching permanent to enter this turn enters as a copy of something or with extra counters, chosen by a payload on the same turn-scoped trigger.
prevent-all-combat-damage with a source filter and/or a recipient filter (you, your creatures), plus an optional intervening-if and a turn-long duration
prevent all damage, combat or not, over a source and/or recipient filter, as a one-shot this-turn effect or a static replacement
a damage replacement (prevent or double) whose source or recipient is the Aura's or Equipment's attached creature, with an optional colour or combat filter
a would-deal-damage replacement whose amount is computed (N, all but N, or half rounded up or down) instead of all-or-none, applied before other replacements
prevent a single target object's damage (dealt to it, by it, or both; combat or all) for a duration: this turn, until your next turn, or while a source remains
a would-deal-damage replacement that sets the amount or adds N (N may be a live amount such as a power), scoped by a source filter and a recipient filter, for a turn or as a static
prevent damage, then a follow-up sized by the amount prevented: add or remove counters, make tokens, exile cards, or deal that much damage to a target
a damage event redirected to a chosen or this object's new target, either only the next damage event or a standing replacement for the turn
prevention whose colour filter is matched against the source (chosen colour or spent mana colour) or against the recipient (shares a colour with it), this turn or as a static
a next-damage shield: the next N, or the next time, damage from a source matching a filter is prevented, for a turn
a damage-can't-be-prevented flag applied to a damage event or for a duration, as a static or a one-shot effect

one would-draw replacement with exemption conditions: skip the first card drawn in each draw step (exceptFirstInDrawStep) and/or apply only the first time each turn, then draw N instead, with drawCountFor honouring both
a would-draw replacement that exiles N cards from the library instead of drawing, with play permission (face down, or playable this turn), tracked per source
a would-draw replacement that takes the drawn card by looking at or revealing library cards from the top and choosing one, the rest binned, revealed or left on top
an enters-battlefield replacement with an alternative cost of sacrificing or discarding matching permanents or cards; if paid the permanent enters, otherwise it goes to its owner's graveyard
a turn-skipping replacement or effect, filtered by whose turn or extra turn is skipped, with an optional untap of the source
an enters-tapped replacement whose StaticCondition reads the cast context (who cast the permanent, or the X it was cast with)

a would-be-put-into-graveyard replacement choosing a destination (top of owner's library, or exile), gated by how the card would get there (dies, discarded by an effect, not cycled, optional on the permanent)
a counter or token multiplier with a scope filter on whose permanents or players it reaches, including an opponent-side multiplier that halves
a tap-for-mana replacement or multiplier with a filter on the land tapped and an override of the mana produced
a would-scry replacement with an alternate outcome: draw that many instead, or scry that many plus a number

count or test the ManaUnits spent on a cast or activation by a filter (source type such as Treasure, or one color), one per-unit record of mana spent that counts matching units and also serves a cast/activation condition
record the mana types, colorless included, spent on a spell or activation, then test whether one type was spent or count the distinct colors spent
per-turn list of creatures declared as attackers, with an optional token or subtype filter, read as a count (the unfiltered count is attacked-with-count)
per-player turn tally of objects put into graveyards, each recorded with its origin zone, card type and controller, counted under any filter

a can't-be-blocked-except-by or unless condition (static, or one-shot for a turn) checked at declare blockers: a count or filter on the blocking creatures (N or more, a filter, all of them), or a condition on the defending player (controls a qualifying permanent, or is the attacking creature's owner)
